AI BIJAN Motion - packed source files of this folder. Do not edit by hand.
The skill upload in the Claude app accepts at most 200 files, so the source files are packed here.
`node <skill folder>/new-project.mjs <project folder> --kit=<style>` unpacks them into the project.
Format: per file one line with four '=' signs, the byte length and the path, then exactly that many bytes.

  "element": "<PanelverseFilms />"
}

==== 7309 scripts/pv-align.mjs
// Word timings for PANELVERSE without whisper.cpp: clause ↔ speech-segment alignment.
//   node scripts/pv-align.mjs <vo.mp3> --script=<text file> --out=src/pv-stories/<id>/words.json [--id=<id>]
// With whisper.cpp installed it hands over to scripts/transcribe.mjs (exact word timings).
// Otherwise: the script is split into clauses at punctuation (. , ! ? ; : …), the VO's speech segments are found with
// silence detection (several thresholds are tried until segments and clauses match one-to-one), and each clause's words
// are spread over its segment by syllable count. Typical error ≈ ±0.1 s per word when the clauses match; if no threshold
// matches, it falls back to transcribe.mjs (sentence-level, ≈ ±0.3–0.5 s) and says so.
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const vo = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
const scriptFile = opt("script"), out = opt("out"), id = opt("id");
if (!vo || !fs.existsSync(vo) || !out) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/pv-align.mjs <vo.mp3> --script=<text file> --out=src/pv-stories/<id>/words.json [--id=<id>]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const run = (c, a) => spawnSync(c, a, { encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 1 << 28 });
const handOver = (why) => {
  console.log(`pv-align: ${why} → scripts/transcribe.mjs`);
  const r = spawnSync("node", [path.join("scripts", "transcribe.mjs"), vo, `--out=${out}`, ...(scriptFile ? [`--script=${scriptFile}`] : []), ...(id ? [`--id=${id}`] : []), "--lang=id"], { stdio: "inherit" });
  process.exit(r.status ?? 1);
};
// whisper.cpp present → exact timings from transcribe.mjs
const hasWhisper = run("sh", ["-c", "command -v whisper-cli"]).stdout.trim() || ["/opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli", "/usr/local/bin/whisper-cli"].some((f) => fs.existsSync(f)) || process.env.WHISPER_CLI;
if (hasWhisper) handOver("whisper.cpp found");
if (!scriptFile || !fs.existsSync(scriptFile)) { console.error("pv-align: without whisper.cpp the VO text is needed: --script=<text file>"); process.exit(1); }
if (id) {
  if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(id)) { console.error(`--id "${id}" must use only a-z, 0-9 and "-"`); process.exit(1); }
  const dst = path.join("public", "audio", `${id}${path.extname(vo).toLowerCase() || ".mp3"}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst), { recursive: true });
  if (path.resolve(dst) !== path.resolve(vo)) fs.copyFileSync(vo, dst);
  console.log(`vo: ${dst}`);
}
const text = fs.readFileSync(scriptFile, "utf8").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
// clauses: words grouped until a punctuation mark closes the clause
const tokens = text.split(" ").filter(Boolean);
const clauses = [];
let cur = [];
for (const t of tokens) {
  cur.push(t);
  if (/[.,!?;:…]["')\]]*$/.test(t)) { clauses.push(cur); cur = []; }
}
if (cur.length) clauses.push(cur);
const duration = Number(run("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", vo]).stdout.trim());
const segmentsFor = (noise, d) => {
  const txt = run("ffmpeg", ["-hide_banner", "-i", vo, "-af", `silencedetect=noise=${noise}dB:d=${d}`, "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
  const starts = [...txt.matchAll(/silence_start: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
  const ends = [...txt.matchAll(/silence_end: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
  // speech = gaps between silences
  const segs = [];
  let t = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < starts.length; i++) {
    if (starts[i] - t > 0.08) segs.push([t, starts[i]]);
    t = ends[i] ?? duration;
  }
  if (duration - t > 0.08) segs.push([t, duration]);
  return segs.filter(([a, b]) => b - a > 0.08);
};
const syl = (w) => Math.max(1, (w.toLowerCase().match(/[aiueoé]+/g) ?? []).length);
const csyl = clauses.map((c) => c.reduce((n, w) => n + syl(w), 0));
const totalSyl = csyl.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
// monotonic alignment: each step pairs 1 clause with 1–4 consecutive segments, or 2–3 clauses with 1 segment.
// cost = squared log ratio of segment speech time to the expected time (syllables × speech rate), weighted by size
const align = (segs) => {
  const C = clauses.length, Sn = segs.length;
  const speech = segs.reduce((n, [a, b]) => n + b - a, 0);
  const rate = speech / totalSyl;
  const segDur = (j0, j1) => segs.slice(j0, j1).reduce((n, [a, b]) => n + b - a, 0);
  const sylOf = (i0, i1) => csyl.slice(i0, i1).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const pairCost = (i0, i1, j0, j1) => {
    const exp = sylOf(i0, i1) * rate, got = segDur(j0, j1);
    const r = Math.log(Math.max(got, 0.05) / Math.max(exp, 0.05));
    return r * r * sylOf(i0, i1) + 0.6 * (i1 - i0 - 1) + 0.4 * (j1 - j0 - 1);
  };
  const INF = 1e9;
  const f = Array.from({ length: C + 1 }, () => new Array(Sn + 1).fill(INF));
  const back = Array.from({ length: C + 1 }, () => new Array(Sn + 1).fill(null));
  f[0][0] = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= C; i++) for (let j = 0; j <= Sn; j++) {
    if (f[i][j] >= INF) continue;
    for (let k = 1; k <= 4 && j + k <= Sn && i + 1 <= C; k++) {
      const c = f[i][j] + pairCost(i, i + 1, j, j + k);
      if (c < f[i + 1][j + k]) { f[i + 1][j + k] = c; back[i + 1][j + k] = [i, j]; }
    }
    for (let k = 2; k <= 3 && i + k <= C && j + 1 <= Sn; k++) {
      const c = f[i][j] + pairCost(i, i + k, j, j + 1);
      if (c < f[i + k][j + 1]) { f[i + k][j + 1] = c; back[i + k][j + 1] = [i, j]; }
    }
  }
  if (f[C][Sn] >= INF) return null;
  const steps = [];
  for (let i = C, j = Sn; i > 0 || j > 0; ) { const [pi, pj] = back[i][j]; steps.unshift([pi, i, pj, j]); i = pi; j = pj; }
  return { cost: f[C][Sn] / totalSyl, steps };
};
let best = null;
for (const noise of [-30, -32, -35, -38, -40, -45]) for (const d of [0.08, 0.1, 0.12, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25]) {
  const segs = segmentsFor(noise, d);
  if (!segs.length) continue;
  const a = align(segs);
  if (a && (!best || a.cost < best.cost)) best = { ...a, segs, noise, d };
}
if (!best || best.cost > 0.35) handOver(best ? `the VO's pauses do not match the script's punctuation well (fit ${best.cost.toFixed(2)})` : "no speech segments found");
const words = [];
for (const [i0, i1, j0, j1] of best.steps) {
  // the clause run's words spread over the segment run's speech time (pauses between segments skipped)
  const segs = best.segs.slice(j0, j1);
  const ws = clauses.slice(i0, i1).flat();
  const n = ws.map(syl), total = n.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const speech = segs.reduce((m, [a, b]) => m + b - a, 0);
  const at = (x) => { // speech-time offset → real time
    for (const [a, b] of segs) { if (x <= b - a) return a + x; x -= b - a; }
    return segs[segs.length - 1][1];
  };
  let acc = 0;
  ws.forEach((w, k) => {
    const dur = (speech * n[k]) / total;
    words.push([w, +at(acc + Math.min(0.01, dur * 0.1)).toFixed(3), +at(acc + dur * 0.94).toFixed(3)]);
    acc += dur;
  });
}
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify(words));
console.log(`words: ${out} — ${words.length} words, ${clauses.length} clauses aligned to ${best.segs.length} speech segments (silence ${best.noise} dB / ${best.d} s, fit ${best.cost.toFixed(3)}), ≈ ±0.1 s per word`);
console.log(words.map(([w, s]) => `${s.toFixed(2)} ${w}`).join("  "));

==== 15147 scripts/pv-make.mjs
// PANELVERSE: one command from a story file to a checked video.
//   node scripts/pv-make.mjs src/pv-stories/<id>/story.ts [--lint] [--stills=2,5.5,9] [--preview] [--final] [--force] [--concurrency=4]
//
//   1. resolve   words.json → words.ts, load the story (Node, type stripping), regenerate src/pv-stories/registry.ts
//   2. lint      validity, safe zone, variety / anti-monotony rules (errors stop; --force to override)
//   3. sound     SFX kit (once) + auto sound cues + ducked mix with the VO → public/audio/<id>-mix.wav
//   4. render    --stills: silent preview frames + sheet · --preview: 540×960@30 with sound ·
//                --final (default): 1080×1920@60, segments (re-run resumes), −14 LUFS master
//   5. QA        scripts/qa.mjs (13 automated checks + contact sheets) + REVIEW.md visual gate

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

if (!process.features.typescript) {
  const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ["--experimental-strip-types", "--no-warnings", ...process.argv.slice(1)], { stdio: "inherit" });
  process.exit(r.status ?? 1);
}
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const file = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const flag = (k) => args.includes(`--${k}`);
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
if (!file || !fs.existsSync(file)) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/pv-make.mjs src/pv-stories/<id>/story.ts [--lint] [--stills=…] [--preview] [--final] [--force]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const step = (s) => console.log(`\n▶ ${s}`);
const sh = (cmd, a) => {
  const r = spawnSync(cmd, a, { stdio: "inherit" });
  if (r.status !== 0) { console.error(`✗ ${cmd} ${a.join(" ")} failed`); process.exit(r.status ?? 1); }
};
const dir = path.dirname(path.resolve(file));
const id = path.basename(dir);
if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(id)) { console.error(`folder name "${id}" must use only a-z, 0-9 and "-" (it is the story id)`); process.exit(1); }

// 1 ── resolve ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
step("resolve story");
const wj = path.join(dir, "words.json"), wt = path.join(dir, "words.ts");
if (!fs.existsSync(wj) && !fs.existsSync(wt)) { console.error(`✗ ${wj} missing — run scripts/transcribe.mjs <vo> --out=${path.relative(".", wj)} first`); process.exit(1); }
if (fs.existsSync(wj) && (!fs.existsSync(wt) || fs.statSync(wj).mtimeMs > fs.statSync(wt).mtimeMs)) {
  const words = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(wj, "utf8")).map((w) => [String(w[0]), Number(w[1]), Number(w[2])]);
  fs.writeFileSync(wt, `// Generated from words.json by scripts/pv-make.mjs — [word, start s, end s] in VO time.\nexport const WORDS = ${JSON.stringify(words)} as const;\n`);
}
let story;
try {
  story = (await import(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(file)).href)).default;
} catch (e) {
  console.error(`✗ the story does not load: ${e.message}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
if (!story || story.id !== id) { console.error(`✗ story.ts must \`export default story({ id: "${id}", … })\` (got id "${story?.id}")`); process.exit(1); }
const voPath = path.join("public", story.vo.file);
if (!fs.existsSync(voPath)) { console.error(`✗ VO not found: ${voPath}`); process.exit(1); }
const voDur = Number(spawnSync("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", voPath], { encoding: "utf8" }).stdout.trim());
const voEndFrame = Math.round((story.vo.offset + voDur) * 60);

// registry: every story folder with a story.ts (+ its elements.tsx)
const root = "src/pv-stories";
const ids = fs.readdirSync(root).filter((d) => fs.existsSync(path.join(root, d, "story.ts"))).sort();
const camel = (s) => "s_" + s.replace(/-/g, "_");
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, "registry.ts"), [
  "// Generated by scripts/pv-make.mjs — every story in src/pv-stories/<id>/ becomes two compositions.",
  'import type { StoryDef } from "../kits/panelverse/director/types.ts";',
  ...ids.flatMap((d) => [`import ${camel(d)} from "./${d}/story.ts";`, ...(fs.existsSync(path.join(root, d, "elements.tsx")) ? [`import "./${d}/elements.tsx";`] : [])]),
  "",
  `export const PV_STORIES: StoryDef[] = [${ids.map(camel).join(", ")}];`,
  "",
].join("\n"));
const rootFile = "src/Root.tsx", rootSrc = fs.readFileSync(rootFile, "utf8");
if (!rootSrc.includes("PanelverseFilms")) {
  const lastImport = [...rootSrc.matchAll(/^import .*;$/gm)].pop(), close = rootSrc.lastIndexOf("</>");
  if (!lastImport || close < 0) { console.error(`✗ add <PanelverseFilms /> (from "./kits/panelverse/Films.tsx") to ${rootFile} by hand`); process.exit(1); }
  const at = lastImport.index + lastImport[0].length;
  const withEl = rootSrc.slice(0, close) + "  <PanelverseFilms />\n  " + rootSrc.slice(close);
  fs.writeFileSync(rootFile, withEl.slice(0, at) + '\nimport { PanelverseFilms } from "./kits/panelverse/Films.tsx";' + withEl.slice(at));
  console.log(`  registered PANELVERSE films in ${rootFile}`);
}
const D = story.durationInFrames;
console.log(`  ${id}: ${(D / 60).toFixed(2)} s · VO ${voDur.toFixed(2)} s from ${story.vo.offset} s · ${Object.keys(story.shots).length} shots · ${story.panels.length} panels · ${story.fx.length} fx · cast ${Object.keys(story.cast).join(", ")}`);

// 2 ── lint ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
step("lint (validity · safe zone · variety)");
const names = (src, re) => [...src.matchAll(re)].map((m) => m[1]);
const libSrc = fs.readFileSync("src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/library.tsx", "utf8");
const items = names(libSrc, /^ {2}(\w+): \{\n\s+desc:/gm);
const elSrc = fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, "elements.tsx")) ? fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, "elements.tsx"), "utf8") : "";
const own = names(elSrc, /(\w+):\s*\{\s*desc:/g);
const props = names(fs.readFileSync("src/kits/panelverse/director/ShotRenderer.tsx", "utf8"), /^ {2}(\w+): \(p/gm);
const { lintStory } = await import(pathToFileURL(path.resolve("src/kits/panelverse/director/lint.ts")).href);
const L = lintStory(story, { voEndFrame, items: [...items, ...own], props });
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(L.stats)) console.log(`  ${k.padEnd(12)} ${v}`);
for (const w of L.warnings) console.log(`  ⚠ ${w}`);
for (const e of L.errors) console.log(`  ✗ ${e}`);
const missing = (story.elements ?? []).filter((e) => !own.includes(e));
if (missing.length) { console.log(`  ✗ story.elements ${missing.join(", ")} not registered in elements.tsx`); L.errors.push("elements"); }
if (L.errors.length && !flag("force")) { console.error(`\n✗ ${L.errors.length} lint error(s) — fix the story (or --force for a test render)`); process.exit(1); }
if (flag("lint")) process.exit(0);

// 3 ── sound ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
step("sound (auto SFX + ducked mix)");
sh(process.execPath, ["scripts/pv-sfx.mjs"]);
const { soundsFor, duckGain } = await import(pathToFileURL(path.resolve("src/kits/panelverse/director/kit.ts")).href);
const cues = soundsFor(story);
const SR = 48000;
const decode = (f) => {
  const r = spawnSync("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-i", f, "-f", "f32le", "-ac", "1", "-ar", String(SR), "-"], { maxBuffer: 1 << 30 });
  return new Float32Array(r.stdout.buffer, r.stdout.byteOffset, Math.floor(r.stdout.length / 4));
};
const N = Math.ceil((D / 60) * SR);
const mix = new Float32Array(N);
const vo = decode(voPath);
const o = Math.round(story.vo.offset * SR);
for (let i = 0; i < vo.length && i + o < N; i++) mix[i + o] += vo[i];
const cache = new Map();
for (const c of cues) {
  const f = path.join("public", c.src);
  if (!fs.existsSync(f)) { console.error(`✗ sound not found: ${f}`); process.exit(1); }
  if (!cache.has(f)) cache.set(f, decode(f));
  const s = cache.get(f), start = Math.round((c.at / 60) * SR);
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length && start + i < N; i++) {
    const fr = (start + i) / SR * 60;
    if (c.until !== undefined && fr >= c.until) break;
    const duck = story.duck ? 1 - (1 - duckGain(story.duck, fr)) * (c.duck ?? 1) : 1;
    const tail = c.until !== undefined ? Math.min(1, (c.until - fr) / 6) : 1;
    mix[start + i] += s[i] * c.volume * duck * tail;
  }
}
let peak = 0;
for (const v of mix) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v));
const g = peak > 0.95 ? 0.95 / peak : 1;
const pcm = Buffer.alloc(N * 4);
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const v = Math.round(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, mix[i] * g)) * 32767); pcm.writeInt16LE(v, i * 4); pcm.writeInt16LE(v, i * 4 + 2); }
const hdr = Buffer.alloc(44);
hdr.write("RIFF", 0); hdr.writeUInt32LE(36 + pcm.length, 4); hdr.write("WAVE", 8); hdr.write("fmt ", 12); hdr.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); hdr.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); hdr.writeUInt16LE(2, 22);
hdr.writeUInt32LE(SR, 24); hdr.writeUInt32LE(SR * 4, 28); hdr.writeUInt16LE(4, 32); hdr.writeUInt16LE(16, 34); hdr.write("data", 36); hdr.writeUInt32LE(pcm.length, 40);
const mixFile = path.join("public", "audio", `${id}-mix.wav`);
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(mixFile), { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(mixFile, Buffer.concat([hdr, pcm]));
console.log(`  ${cues.length} sound cues → ${mixFile}${g < 1 ? ` (scaled ${g.toFixed(2)} to avoid clipping)` : ""}`);

// plan for the record (and for revisions)
const outDir = path.join("out", id);
fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
const shots = story.panels.map((p) => ({ kind: "panel", a: p.shot, t0: p.from / 60, t1: Math.min(p.to, D) / 60 }));
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, "shots.json"), JSON.stringify({ duration: D / 60, voOffset: story.vo.offset, shots }, null, 1));
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, "plan.txt"), [
  `${id} — ${(D / 60).toFixed(2)} s`,
  ...Object.entries(L.stats).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${v}`),
  "", "beats:", ...(story.beats ?? []).map((b) => `  ${(b.at / 60).toFixed(2).padStart(6)} s  "${b.words}" → ${b.idea} [${b.device}]`),
  "", "panels:", ...story.panels.map((p) => `  ${(p.from / 60).toFixed(2).padStart(6)}–${(p.to / 60).toFixed(2).padEnd(6)} ${p.shot} ${(p.moves ?? []).map((m) => `${m.type}@${(m.at / 60).toFixed(2)}`).join(" ")}`),
  "", "sound:", ...cues.map((c) => `  ${(c.at / 60).toFixed(2).padStart(6)} s  ${path.basename(c.src)} ×${c.volume}`),
  ...(L.warnings.length ? ["", "warnings:", ...L.warnings.map((w) => `  ${w}`)] : []),
].join("\n") + "\n");

// 4 ── render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const stills = opt("stills");
if (stills) {
  step("stills");
  const all = stills.split(",").map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const ok = all.filter((x) => x >= 0 && x < D / 60 - 0.05);
  if (!ok.length) { console.error("✗ no stills inside the film"); process.exit(1); }
  sh("node", ["scripts/stills.mjs", path.join(outDir, "stills"), ok.map((x) => `${x}s`).join(","), `${id}-stills`]);
}
const preview = flag("preview"), final = flag("final") || (!preview && !stills);
let video = null;
if (preview) {
  step("render preview (540×960 @ 30, with sound)");
  video = path.join(outDir, `${id}_preview.mp4`);
  sh("npx", ["remotion", "render", `${id}-preview`, video, "--codec=h264", "--crf=20", `--concurrency=${opt("concurrency", "4")}`]);
}
if (final) {
  step("render final (1080×1920 @ 60, H.264 + AAC, −14 LUFS)");
  const seg = path.join(outDir, "seg"), stamp = path.join(seg, "stamp.txt");
  const h = crypto.createHash("sha1");
  for (const f of [file, wt, path.join(dir, "elements.tsx"), mixFile]) if (fs.existsSync(f)) h.update(fs.readFileSync(f));
  const sig = h.digest("hex");
  if (!fs.existsSync(stamp) || fs.readFileSync(stamp, "utf8") !== sig) fs.rmSync(seg, { recursive: true, force: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(seg, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(stamp, sig);
  video = path.join(outDir, `${id}_1080x1920_60fps.mp4`);
  sh("node", ["scripts/render-final.mjs", `--comp=${id}-final`, `--out=${video}`, `--vo=${mixFile}`, "--offset=0", "--parts=4", `--concurrency=${opt("concurrency", "4")}`, `--seg=${seg}`]);
}

// 5 ── QA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (video && !flag("no-qa")) {
  step("QA");
  const qa = spawnSync("node", ["scripts/qa.mjs", video, `--vo=${voPath}`, `--offset=${story.vo.offset}`, `--expect=${(D / 60).toFixed(3)}`, `--shots=${path.join(outDir, "shots.json")}`, ...(final ? ["--final"] : []), ...(final ? [] : ["--size=540x960"])], { stdio: "inherit" });
  const qaDir = path.join(outDir, "qa");
  const pages = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(qaDir, "qa.json"), "utf8")).contactPages ?? [];
  const rows = [
    "every beat reads with the sound off (the picture says what the VO says)",
    "faces readable in every shot that carries an emotion; no face hidden by props, bubbles or lettering",
    "lettering fully in frame, inside the safe zone, spelled right, never over a face",
    "no limbs at odd angles; nobody inside furniture or another person; hands touch what they hold",
    "panels: borders clean, no gaps / slivers at transitions, content does not slide inside a moving panel",
    "no camera inside or against walls / props; nothing cut at an edge that matters",
    "variety: layouts, transitions and devices change with the beats — no stretch feels repeated or static",
    "the story's own elements appear and read (they were made for this script)",
    "frame errors: black / white / frozen / flicker, burnt highlights, blank page",
    "VO sync: events land on their words; the narration is never covered by a sound",
    "ending lands (freeze / page / punchline) and holds long enough",
  ];
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(qaDir, "REVIEW.md"), [
    `# Visual review — ${id} (${path.basename(video)})`, "", "STATUS: PENDING VISUAL REVIEW", "",
    `Look at EVERY page of the 1-fps contact sheet — ${pages.map((p) => `${p.file} (${p.from}–${p.to} s)`).join(", ") || "contact_1fps_*.jpg"} — and shots_start_mid_end.jpg; open the video for anything doubtful, especially transitions. Tick each page below.`, "",
    ...pages.map((p) => `- [ ] ${p.file} (${p.from}–${p.to} s) seen`), "",
    "Then fill every row with PASS / FIX + what you saw. Set STATUS to PASS only when no FIX is left.", "",
    "| check | verdict | notes |", "|---|---|---|", ...rows.map((r) => `| ${r} | | |`), "",
  ].join("\n"));
  console.log(`  review gate → ${path.join(qaDir, "REVIEW.md")} (PENDING until a visual review is written)`);
  if (qa.status !== 0) process.exit(qa.status ?? 3);
}
console.log(`\n✓ done${video ? `: ${video}` : ""}`);

==== 16797 scripts/pv-sfx.mjs
// PANELVERSE sound kit — every effect is synthesised here from oscillators + filtered noise.
// Deterministic (seeded PRNG), dependency-free, original (no samples, no licensing questions).
//   node scripts/pv-sfx.mjs            → public/sfx/pv-*.wav  (48 kHz, mono, 16-bit; skips existing files)
//   node scripts/pv-sfx.mjs --force    → rebuild all
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const SR = 48000;
const OUT = path.resolve("public/sfx");
fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });

// ── primitives ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const rng = (seed) => () => {
  seed |= 0;
  seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
  let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
  t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
  return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
};
const buf = (sec) => new Float32Array(Math.max(1, Math.round(sec * SR)));
const white = (n, seed) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  const b = new Float32Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) b[i] = r() * 2 - 1;
  return b;
};
const brown = (n, seed) => {
  const w = white(n, seed);
  let acc = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    acc = (acc + w[i] * 0.02) * 0.998;
    w[i] = acc * 3.5;
  }
  return w;
};
/** RBJ biquad; `f` may be a number or a function of sample index (sweeps). */
const biquad = (x, type, f, q = 0.707) => {
  const y = new Float32Array(x.length);
  let x1 = 0, x2 = 0, y1 = 0, y2 = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
    const fc = Math.min(SR * 0.45, Math.max(20, typeof f === "function" ? f(i) : f));
    const w = (2 * Math.PI * fc) / SR;
    const c = Math.cos(w), s = Math.sin(w), a = s / (2 * q);
    let b0, b1, b2;
    if (type === "lp") { b0 = (1 - c) / 2; b1 = 1 - c; b2 = (1 - c) / 2; }
    else if (type === "hp") { b0 = (1 + c) / 2; b1 = -(1 + c); b2 = (1 + c) / 2; }
    else { b0 = a; b1 = 0; b2 = -a; } // band-pass (constant 0 dB peak)
    const a0 = 1 + a, a1 = -2 * c, a2 = 1 - a;
    const out = (b0 * x[i] + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 - a1 * y1 - a2 * y2) / a0;
    x2 = x1; x1 = x[i]; y2 = y1; y1 = out;
    y[i] = out;
  }
  return y;
};
/** sine with a frequency function f(t) (Hz) — phase-accumulated so glides are clean */
const osc = (sec, f, shape = "sin") => {
  const b = buf(sec);
  let ph = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) {
    const t = i / SR;
    ph += (2 * Math.PI * (typeof f === "function" ? f(t) : f)) / SR;
    b[i] = shape === "sq" ? Math.tanh(Math.sin(ph) * 4) : shape === "tri" ? (2 / Math.PI) * Math.asin(Math.sin(ph)) : Math.sin(ph);
  }
  return b;
};
const env = (b, fn) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) b[i] *= fn(i / SR, i / b.length);
  return b;
};
const adsr = (a, d) => (t) => (t < a ? t / a : Math.exp(-(t - a) / d));
const bell = (t, len) => Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, t / len)));
const gain = (b, g) => b.map((v) => v * g);
const mixInto = (dst, src, at = 0, g = 1) => {
  const o = Math.round(at * SR);
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length && i + o < dst.length; i++) if (i + o >= 0) dst[i + o] += src[i] * g;
  return dst;
};
const sat = (b, drive) => b.map((v) => Math.tanh(v * drive) / Math.tanh(drive));
const fadeOut = (b, sec = 0.01) => {
  const n = Math.round(sec * SR);
  for (let i = 0; i < n && i < b.length; i++) b[b.length - 1 - i] *= i / n;
  return b;
};
const normalize = (b, peak = 0.89) => {
  let m = 0;
  for (const v of b) m = Math.max(m, Math.abs(v));
  return m > 0 ? gain(b, peak / m) : b;
};
const writeWav = (name, b) => {
  b = fadeOut(normalize(b));
  const data = Buffer.alloc(b.length * 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) data.writeInt16LE(Math.round(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, b[i])) * 32767), i * 2);
  const h = Buffer.alloc(44);
  h.write("RIFF", 0); h.writeUInt32LE(36 + data.length, 4); h.write("WAVE", 8); h.write("fmt ", 12);
  h.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); h.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); h.writeUInt16LE(1, 22); h.writeUInt32LE(SR, 24);
  h.writeUInt32LE(SR * 2, 28); h.writeUInt16LE(2, 32); h.writeUInt16LE(16, 34); h.write("data", 36); h.writeUInt32LE(data.length, 40);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `pv-${name}.wav`), Buffer.concat([h, data]));
};

// ── building blocks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const click = (sec, fc, seed, decay = 0.004) => env(biquad(white(Math.round(sec * SR), seed), "bp", fc, 1.2), adsr(0.0005, decay));
const thump = (f0, f1, sec, decay) => env(osc(sec, (t) => f1 + (f0 - f1) * Math.exp(-t * 18)), adsr(0.002, decay));
const sweepNoise = (sec, f0, f1, q, seed, shape = (t, k) => bell(k, 1)) => {
  const n = Math.round(sec * SR);
  return env(biquad(white(n, seed), "bp", (i) => f0 * Math.pow(f1 / f0, i / n), q), shape);
};
const bellTone = (sec, f, partials = [[1, 1], [2.76, 0.45], [5.4, 0.22]], decay = 0.35) => {
  const b = buf(sec);
  for (const [m, a] of partials) mixInto(b, env(osc(sec, f * m), adsr(0.002, decay / Math.sqrt(m))), 0, a);
  return b;
};

// ── the kit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const S = {};
// phone & chat
S.tap = () => mixInto(click(0.05, 2600, 11, 0.006), env(osc(0.05, 1800), adsr(0.001, 0.012)), 0, 0.25);
S.tap2 = () => mixInto(click(0.05, 3100, 12, 0.005), env(osc(0.05, 2100), adsr(0.001, 0.01)), 0, 0.25);
S.send = () => {
  const b = sweepNoise(0.42, 350, 3800, 2.2, 21, (t, k) => Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * k), 1.5));
  return mixInto(b, env(osc(0.12, (t) => 500 + 1400 * t * 8), adsr(0.002, 0.05)), 0.3, 0.5);
};
S.blip = () => mixInto(env(osc(0.14, 1240), adsr(0.002, 0.04)), env(osc(0.14, 2480), adsr(0.002, 0.025)), 0, 0.3);
S.ding = () => {
  const b = buf(0.9);
  mixInto(b, bellTone(0.9, 1318.5, undefined, 0.3), 0, 0.8);
  mixInto(b, bellTone(0.8, 1975.5, undefined, 0.35), 0.09, 1);
  return b;
};
S.pop = () => mixInto(env(osc(0.12, (t) => 280 + 700 * Math.exp(-t * 60)), adsr(0.001, 0.035)), click(0.02, 3000, 5, 0.002), 0, 0.6);
const buzzPulses = (pulses) => {
  const b = buf(0.3 + pulses[pulses.length - 1]);
  for (const at of pulses) {
    const tone = env(biquad(osc(0.24, 168, "sq"), "lp", 900), (t) => Math.min(1, t / 0.01) * Math.min(1, (0.24 - t) / 0.02));
    const rattle = env(biquad(white(tone.length, 33 + at * 10), "bp", 2200, 3), (t) => 0.4 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 2 * Math.PI * 84)));
    mixInto(b, tone, at, 0.9);
    mixInto(b, rattle, at, 0.25);
  }
  return b;
};
S.buzz = () => buzzPulses([0, 0.32]);
S.buzz1 = () => buzzPulses([0]); // single rattle, over before the next spoken word
S.punch = () => {
  const b = buf(0.6);
  mixInto(b, sweepNoise(0.12, 800, 3500, 1.5, 41, (t, k) => k * k), 0, 0.5); // pre-whoosh
  mixInto(b, sat(thump(140, 42, 0.45, 0.16), 2.2), 0.1, 1);
  mixInto(b, env(biquad(white(Math.round(0.05 * SR), 42), "lp", 2200), adsr(0.001, 0.02)), 0.1, 0.6);
  return b;
};
/** low-end only impact: lands under a spoken word without masking it */
S.punchDry = () => sat(biquad(thump(130, 40, 0.5, 0.17), "lp", 260), 2);
// freeze & overthinking

  const b = buf(1.4);

  mixInto(b, env(osc(1.4, (t) => 62 - 20 * t), adsr(0.004, 0.55)), 0, 1);
  mixInto(b, env(biquad(white(Math.round(1.2 * SR), 51), "hp", 6000), adsr(0.002, 0.25)), 0, 0.25);
  return b;
};

  const sec = 1.15;

    mixInto(b, env(osc(sec, (t) => (230 + 520 * Math.pow(t / sec, 1.6)) * det * (1 + 0.012 * Math.sin(t * 2 * Math.PI * (4 + 7 * t)))), (t) => Math.min(1, t / 0.3)), 0, a);
  }
  mixInto(b, sweepNoise(sec, 300, 3000, 1.2, 52, (t, k) => k), 0, 0.5);
  return b;
};

// page / panels

S.hiss = () => env(biquad(white(Math.round(1.1 * SR), 121), "hp", 3800), (t) => Math.min(1, t / 0.15) * Math.min(1, (1.1 - t) / 0.3) * (0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 2 * Math.PI * 9)));

const tinkles = (sec, count, seed, fLo = 2000, fHi = 7000) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  const b = buf(sec);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const at = Math.pow(r(), 1.8) * sec * 0.75;

    mixInto(b, env(osc(0.12, f), adsr(0.0008, 0.02 + r() * 0.05)), at, 0.25 + r() * 0.4);
  }
  return b;
};

S.sadTrombone = () => {
  const b = buf(2.0);
  [[392, 0.0, 0.32], [370, 0.36, 0.32], [349, 0.72, 0.32], [330, 1.08, 0.85]].forEach(([fq, at, len], i) => {
    const tone = env(biquad(osc(len, (t) => fq * (1 + (i === 3 ? 0.03 * Math.sin(t * 2 * Math.PI * 6) : 0)), "sq"), "lp", 1100, 1.2), (t) => Math.min(1, t / 0.03) * Math.min(1, (len - t) / 0.08));
    mixInto(b, tone, at, 0.8);
  });
  return b;
};

const force = process.argv.includes("--force");
let made = 0;
for (const [name, make] of Object.entries(S)) {
  if (!force && fs.existsSync(path.join(OUT, `pv-${name}.wav`))) continue;
  writeWav(name, make());
  made++;
}
console.log(`sfx kit: ${made} built, ${Object.keys(S).length} total → ${OUT}`);

==== 12702 scripts/qa.mjs
// Automated QA of a rendered video. Writes out/<id>/qa/{qa.json, contact_1fps_001.jpg …, shots_start_mid_end.jpg}
// (the 1-fps contact sheet covers the whole video in pages of 96 seconds, each tile stamped with its second)
// and prints PASS/FAIL per check. The contact sheets are for the visual review that follows.
//   node scripts/qa.mjs <video.mp4> --vo=public/audio/x.mp3 --offset=0.4 --expect=49.8 [--shots=out/<id>/shots.json] [--final]
//                       [--size=1080x1920] [--from=12]   (--from: the video is a section starting at that film second)

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const video = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
const final = args.includes("--final");
if (!video || !fs.existsSync(video)) { console.error("usage: node scripts/qa.mjs <video.mp4> --vo=… --offset=… --expect=… [--shots=…] [--final]"); process.exit(1); }
const run = (c, a) => spawnSync(c, a, { encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 1 << 30 });
const qaDir = path.join(path.dirname(video), "qa");
fs.mkdirSync(qaDir, { recursive: true });
const checks = [];
const check = (name, ok, detail) => { checks.push({ name, ok, detail }); console.log(`  ${ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL"}  ${name}: ${detail}`); };

// streams
const probe = JSON.parse(run("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-show_streams", "-show_format", "-of", "json", video]).stdout);
const v = probe.streams.find((s) => s.codec_type === "video"), a = probe.streams.find((s) => s.codec_type === "audio");
const dur = Number(probe.format.duration), expect = Number(opt("expect", dur));
const [fn, fd] = v.r_frame_rate.split("/").map(Number);
const fps = fn / fd;
const [sw, shh] = opt("size", "1080x1920").split("x").map(Number);
const portraitV = shh > sw;
// previews are half size; finals must be the exact delivery size at 60 fps
const sizeOk = final ? v.width === sw && v.height === shh && Math.abs(fps - 60) < 0.01 : Math.abs(v.width / v.height - sw / shh) < 0.01;
check("video stream", v.codec_name === "h264" && sizeOk, `${v.codec_name} ${v.width}×${v.height} @ ${fps} fps${final ? ` (final must be ${sw}×${shh} @ 60)` : ` (${portraitV ? "portrait" : "landscape"} aspect)`}`);
check("audio stream", !!a && a.codec_name === "aac", a ? `${a.codec_name} ${a.sample_rate} Hz, ${Number(a.duration ?? dur).toFixed(2)} s` : "missing");
check("duration", Math.abs(dur - expect) < 0.12, `${dur.toFixed(2)} s (expected ${expect.toFixed(2)} s)`);
if (a) check("audio length = video length", Math.abs(Number(a.duration ?? dur) - dur) < 0.15, `${Number(a.duration ?? dur).toFixed(2)} vs ${dur.toFixed(2)} s`);

// frame scan: white / black / sudden flashes
const ylog = path.join(qaDir, "yavg.txt");
run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-i", video, "-vf", `scale=192:108,signalstats,metadata=mode=print:file=${ylog}`, "-f", "null", "-"]);
const ytxt = fs.readFileSync(ylog, "utf8");
const y = (ytxt.match(/YAVG=[\d.]+/g) ?? []).map((s) => Number(s.slice(5)));
// 90th percentile luma per frame (video range: black is 16) — a frame whose p90 stays ≤ 24 is practically black
const y90 = (ytxt.match(/YHIGH=[\d.]+/g) ?? []).map((s) => Number(s.slice(6)));
// black: the opening fade, scene fades and the end card may be dark on purpose — only long runs fail
const white = y.filter((x) => x > 225).length;
// blown highlights: share of the picture burnt to white (a lamp in close-up, bloom) — the mean luma misses it
const hlog = path.join(qaDir, "hot.txt");
// the middle of the frame (a bright sky at the top is not a lamp in the lens); video range: white is 235
run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-i", video, "-vf", `crop=iw*0.7:ih*0.6:iw*0.15:ih*0.2,scale=160:120,lutyuv=y='if(gt(val,222),255,0)',signalstats,metadata=mode=print:key=lavfi.signalstats.YAVG:file=${hlog}`, "-f", "null", "-"]);
const hot = (fs.readFileSync(hlog, "utf8").match(/YAVG=[\d.]+/g) ?? []).map((s) => Number(s.slice(5)) / 255);
let hr = 0, hotLongest = 0, hotAt = -1;
hot.forEach((x, i) => { hr = x > 0.12 ? hr + 1 : 0; if (hr > hotLongest) { hotLongest = hr; hotAt = (i - hr + 1) / fps; } });
let run0 = 0, longest = 0;
y.slice(Math.round(fps * 0.9), y.length - Math.round(fps * 1.2)).forEach((x) => { run0 = x < 7 ? run0 + 1 : 0; longest = Math.max(longest, run0); });
const black = longest > fps * 0.7 ? longest : 0;
check("no white frames", white === 0, `${white} frames with mean luma > 225`);
check("no blown-out highlights", hotLongest < fps * 0.5, hotLongest ? `${(hotLongest / fps).toFixed(1)} s with > 12 % of the middle of the picture burnt white (from ${(hotAt + Number(opt("from", 0))).toFixed(1)} s) — a lamp / bloom too close` : "none");
check("no black gaps (outside fades)", black === 0, `longest near-black run ${(longest / fps).toFixed(2)} s (fails above 0.7 s)`);
// frozen picture (a stuck render shows as identical frames)
const fz = run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "info", "-i", video, "-vf", "scale=320:180,freezedetect=n=0.0006:d=2.5", "-an", "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
const freezes = [...fz.matchAll(/freeze_start: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1])).filter((t) => t > 1 && t < dur - 6);
check("no frozen picture", freezes.length === 0, freezes.length ? `frozen from ${freezes.map((t) => t.toFixed(1)).join(", ")} s` : "none (≥ 2.5 s)");
// loudness (final delivery is mastered to −14 LUFS, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP)
if (a) {
  const lu = run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "info", "-nostats", "-i", video, "-vn", "-af", "ebur128=peak=true", "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
  const I = Number((lu.match(/I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS/g) ?? []).pop()?.match(/-?[\d.]+/)?.[0]);
  const TP = Number((lu.match(/Peak:\s+(-?[\d.]+) dBFS/g) ?? []).pop()?.match(/-?[\d.]+/)?.[0]);
  check("loudness", !final || (Math.abs(I + 14) < 1.2 && TP <= -0.8), `${I.toFixed(1)} LUFS integrated, true peak ${TP.toFixed(1)} dBTP${final ? " (target −14 LUFS, ≤ −1 dBTP)" : ""}`);
}
const jumps = [];
for (let i = 1; i < y.length; i++) if (Math.abs(y[i] - y[i - 1]) > 45) jumps.push(+(i / fps).toFixed(2));
console.log(`  info  luma ${Math.min(...y).toFixed(0)}–${Math.max(...y).toFixed(0)}, big jumps (cuts) at ${jumps.join(", ") || "none"}`);

// VO sync: cross-correlate the film's audio with the VO around the expected offset
const voFile = opt("vo"), off0 = Number(opt("offset", 0)), section = opt("from") !== "";
// a section that starts after the VO has begun: compare with the VO from that point (expected lag 0)
const voSkip = Math.max(0, -off0), off = Math.max(0, off0);
if (voFile && fs.existsSync(voFile)) {
  const SR = 8000;
  const raw = (f, ss = 0) => { const r = spawnSync("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", ...(ss ? ["-ss", ss.toFixed(3)] : []), "-i", f, "-f", "f32le", "-ac", "1", "-ar", String(SR), "-"], { maxBuffer: 1 << 30 }); return new Float32Array(r.stdout.buffer, r.stdout.byteOffset, Math.floor(r.stdout.length / 4)); };
  const film = raw(video), vo = raw(voFile, voSkip);
  let best = -1, lag = 0;
  for (let L = Math.round((off - 0.25) * SR); L <= Math.round((off + 0.25) * SR); L++) {
    if (L < 0) continue;
    let s = 0, e1 = 0, e2 = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < vo.length && i + L < film.length; i += 3) { const p = vo[i], q = film[i + L]; s += p * q; e1 += p * p; e2 += q * q; }
    const c = s / Math.sqrt(e1 * e2 + 1e-12);
    if (c > best) { best = c; lag = L; }
  }
  const err = lag / SR - off;
  check("VO sync", Math.abs(err) < 0.03 && best > 0.6, `VO found at ${(lag / SR).toFixed(3)} s (expected ${off.toFixed(3)}, error ${(err * 1000).toFixed(0)} ms, correlation ${best.toFixed(2)})`);
  const voEnd = off + vo.length / SR;
  if (!section) check("VO not cut", voEnd <= dur + 0.02, `VO ends at ${voEnd.toFixed(2)} s, video ${dur.toFixed(2)} s`);
}

// contact sheets (portrait: tall tiles): one tile per second for the WHOLE video, 96 per page
// (contact_1fps_001.jpg, _002.jpg …), every tile stamped with its film second so nothing can be skipped unseen
const tw = portraitV ? 180 : 320, thh = portraitV ? 320 : 180;
const grid = portraitV ? [12, 8] : [8, 12], perPage = grid[0] * grid[1];
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(qaDir)) if (/^contact_1fps(_\d+)?\.jpg$/.test(f)) fs.rmSync(path.join(qaDir, f));
// a second stamp on each tile when this ffmpeg has drawtext (not every build does); the page ranges are always listed
const hasDrawtext = /drawtext/.test(run("ffmpeg", ["-hide_banner", "-filters"]).stdout ?? "");
const fontFile = ["/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf", "/Library/Fonts/Arial.ttf", "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", "C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf"].find((f) => fs.existsSync(f));
const t0s = Number(opt("from", 0));
const stamp = hasDrawtext && fontFile ? `,drawtext=fontfile='${fontFile}':text='%{eif\\:t+${t0s}\\:d}s':x=6:y=6:fontsize=${portraitV ? 22 : 20}:fontcolor=yellow:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.6` : "";
const sheetArgs = (sync) => ["-v", "error", "-y", "-i", video, "-vf", `fps=1,scale=${tw}:${thh}${stamp},tile=${grid[0]}x${grid[1]}`, ...sync, "-start_number", "1", path.join(qaDir, "contact_1fps_%03d.jpg")];
// one output image per full (or last, partial) page: -fps_mode on ffmpeg ≥ 5.1, -vsync on older builds
if (run("ffmpeg", sheetArgs(["-fps_mode", "passthrough"])).status !== 0) run("ffmpeg", sheetArgs(["-vsync", "0"]));
const pages = fs.readdirSync(qaDir).filter((f) => /^contact_1fps_\d+\.jpg$/.test(f)).sort();
const needPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.floor(dur) / perPage));
const pageRanges = pages.map((f, i) => ({ file: f, from: Math.round(t0s + i * perPage), to: Math.round(t0s + Math.min(dur, (i + 1) * perPage)) }));
check("contact sheet covers the whole video", pages.length >= needPages, `${pages.length} page(s) of ${perPage} s for ${dur.toFixed(1)} s: ${pageRanges.map((p) => `${p.file} ${p.from}–${p.to} s`).join(", ")}${stamp ? "" : " (tiles not stamped: this ffmpeg has no drawtext — tiles run left→right, top→bottom, one per second)"}`);
const shotsFile = opt("shots");
const from = Number(opt("from", 0));
if (shotsFile && fs.existsSync(shotsFile)) {
  const { shots: all } = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(shotsFile, "utf8"));
  // shots of this video (a section: only those inside it, in video time)
  const shots = all.map((s) => ({ ...s, t0: Math.max(0, s.t0 - from), t1: Math.min(dur, s.t1 - from) })).filter((s) => s.t1 - s.t0 > 0.2);
  // phone readability: the middle of every shot must not sink into black (night ≠ unreadable)
  const dark = shots.filter((s) => { const i = Math.round(((s.t0 + s.t1) / 2) * fps); return y[i] !== undefined && y[i] < 22 && !(s.t0 < 1); });
  // a shot that is practically black for its whole length shows nothing on a phone (darkness needs a sliver of light)
  const black = shots.filter((s) => { if (s.t1 - s.t0 < 1.4 || s.t0 < 1 || s.t1 > dur - 1) return false; const a = Math.round((s.t0 + 0.3) * fps), b = Math.round((s.t1 - 0.3) * fps); const seg = y.slice(a, b); return seg.length && Math.max(...y90.slice(a, b)) <= 24; });
  check("readable on a phone (not too dark)", dark.length <= Math.max(1, Math.floor(shots.length * 0.15)) && black.length === 0, `${dark.length}/${shots.length} shots with mid-frame mean luma < 22${dark.length ? ` (at ${dark.map((s) => (s.t0 + from).toFixed(1)).join(", ")} s)` : ""}${black.length ? ` · ${black.length} practically black shot(s) at ${black.map((s) => (s.t0 + from).toFixed(1)).join(", ")} s` : ""}`);
  const tmp = path.join(qaDir, "tmp");
  fs.mkdirSync(tmp, { recursive: true });
  let n = 0;
  for (const s of shots) for (const f of [0.12, 0.5, 0.88]) {
    const t = Math.min(dur - 0.05, s.t0 + (s.t1 - s.t0) * f);
    run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-ss", t.toFixed(3), "-i", video, "-frames:v", "1", "-vf", `scale=${tw}:${thh}`, path.join(tmp, `f${String(n++).padStart(3, "0")}.png`)]);
  }
  const cols = portraitV ? 9 : 6;
  run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-pattern_type", "glob", "-i", path.join(tmp, "f*.png"), "-vf", `tile=${cols}x${Math.ceil(n / cols)}`, "-frames:v", "1", path.join(qaDir, "shots_start_mid_end.jpg")]);
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
  console.log(`  info  ${shots.length} shots sampled at start/middle/end → ${path.join(qaDir, "shots_start_mid_end.jpg")}`);
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(qaDir, "qa.json"), JSON.stringify({ video, duration: dur, fps, checks, cutsAt: jumps, contactSheets: pages, contactPages: pageRanges }, null, 1));
const failed = checks.filter((c) => !c.ok);
console.log(failed.length ? `\nQA: ${failed.length} check(s) FAILED — fix before delivering` : `\nQA: all ${checks.length} automated checks passed — now review ${qaDir}/*.jpg`);
process.exit(failed.length ? 3 : 0);

==== 6401 scripts/transcribe.mjs
// Word timings for a voice-over → JSON [[word, start, end], …] (VO seconds).
//   node scripts/transcribe.mjs <vo.mp3> --out=stories/<id>/words.json [--script=script.txt] [--lang=id]
//   node scripts/transcribe.mjs <any/path/vo.mp3> --id=<id> [--script=…]   copies the VO to public/audio/<id>.<ext>
//                                                                          and writes stories/<id>/words.json
//
// 1. whisper.cpp when available (WHISPER_CLI + WHISPER_MODEL, or `whisper-cli` on PATH with a model in
//    ~/.cache/whisper.cpp or ./models) — real word timings.
// 2. otherwise, with the script text: the VO's speech segments (silence detection) are matched to the
//    script's sentences and words are spread by length inside each segment — close enough for beats
//    and captions, not exact per word.
// Without whisper and without a script there is nothing to align: the script text must be provided.

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const file = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
const id = opt("id");
if (id && !/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(id)) { console.error(`--id "${id}" must use only a-z, 0-9 and "-"`); process.exit(1); }
const out = opt("out") || (id ? `stories/${id}/words.json` : "");
if (file && fs.existsSync(file) && id) {
  const dst = path.join("public", "audio", `${id}${path.extname(file).toLowerCase() || ".mp3"}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst), { recursive: true });
  if (path.resolve(dst) !== path.resolve(file)) fs.copyFileSync(file, dst);
  console.log(`vo: ${dst}  →  story.json "vo": { "file": "${path.relative("public", dst)}", "offset": 0.4 }`);
}
if (!file || !fs.existsSync(file) || !out) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/transcribe.mjs <vo.mp3> (--id=<id> | --out=stories/<id>/words.json) [--script=script.txt] [--lang=id]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const run = (cmd, a) => spawnSync(cmd, a, { encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 1 << 28 });
const duration = Number(run("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", file]).stdout.trim());

const findWhisper = () => {
  const home = os.homedir();
  const cands = [process.env.WHISPER_CLI, run("sh", ["-c", "command -v whisper-cli"]).stdout.trim(), "/opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli", "/usr/local/bin/whisper-cli"].filter(Boolean);
  const cli = cands.find((c) => fs.existsSync(c));
  const modelDirs = [path.join(home, ".cache/whisper.cpp"), path.resolve("models"), "/opt/homebrew/share/whisper-cpp"];
  let model = process.env.WHISPER_MODEL && fs.existsSync(process.env.WHISPER_MODEL) ? process.env.WHISPER_MODEL : null;
  if (!model) for (const d of modelDirs) { if (!fs.existsSync(d)) continue; const m = fs.readdirSync(d).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".bin")).sort((a, b) => (b.includes("large") ? 1 : 0) - (a.includes("large") ? 1 : 0))[0]; if (m) { model = path.join(d, m); break; } }
  return cli && model ? { cli, model } : null;
};

let words = null, method = "";
const W = findWhisper();
if (W) {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "cf-vo-"));
  const wav = path.join(tmp, "vo16k.wav");
  run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-i", file, "-ar", "16000", "-ac", "1", wav]);
  run(W.cli, ["-m", W.model, "-f", wav, "-l", opt("lang", "id"), "-ml", "1", "-sow", "-ojf", "-of", path.join(tmp, "w")]);
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp, "w.json"), "utf8"));
    words = j.transcription.map((s) => [s.text.trim(), s.offsets.from / 1000, s.offsets.to / 1000]).filter((w) => w[0]);
    method = `whisper.cpp (${path.basename(W.model)})`;
  } catch { words = null; }
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

if (!words) {
  const scriptFile = opt("script");
  if (!scriptFile || !fs.existsSync(scriptFile)) {
    console.error("No whisper.cpp found and no --script given. Provide the narration text (e.g. --script=stories/<id>/script.txt) or install whisper.cpp (see the skill's references/setup.md).");
    process.exit(2);
  }
  const text = fs.readFileSync(scriptFile, "utf8").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  // speech segments from silence detection
  const log = run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "info", "-i", file, "-af", "silencedetect=n=-38dB:d=0.18", "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
  const st = [...log.matchAll(/silence_start: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
  const en = [...log.matchAll(/silence_end: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
  const segs = [];
  let cur = 0;
  st.forEach((s, i) => { if (s - cur > 0.12) segs.push([cur, s]); cur = en[i] ?? duration; });
  if (duration - cur > 0.12) segs.push([cur, duration]);
  const toks = text.split(" ").filter(Boolean);
  // sentences / clauses = groups ending in punctuation; map groups to segments by cumulative length
  const total = toks.reduce((s, w) => s + w.length + 1, 0);
  const speech = segs.reduce((s, [a, b]) => s + (b - a), 0);
  // speech-time position for a fraction of the text, then into real time through the segments
  const toTime = (frac) => {
    let need = frac * speech;
    for (const [a, b] of segs) { if (need <= b - a) return a + need; need -= b - a; }
    return segs.length ? segs[segs.length - 1][1] : duration;
  };
  // snap clause ends to the nearest segment end when one is close
  let acc = 0;
  words = toks.map((w) => {
    const a = acc / total;
    acc += w.length + 1;
    const b = (acc - 1) / total;
    let t0 = toTime(a), t1 = toTime(b);
    if (/[.,?!;:]$/.test(w)) { const near = segs.map((s) => s[1]).reduce((best, e) => (Math.abs(e - t1) < Math.abs(best - t1) ? e : best), t1); if (Math.abs(near - t1) < 0.6) t1 = near; }
    return [w, +t0.toFixed(2), +Math.max(t0 + 0.08, t1).toFixed(2)];
  });
  // keep times monotonic
  for (let i = 1; i < words.length; i++) if (words[i][1] < words[i - 1][2]) words[i][1] = words[i - 1][2];
  method = `script aligned to ${segs.length} speech segments (approximate word timing)`;
}

fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify(words.map(([w, a, b]) => [w, +a.toFixed(2), +b.toFixed(2)])));
console.log(`words: ${out} — ${words.length} words, ${duration.toFixed(2)} s, via ${method}`);
console.log(words.map(([w, a]) => `${a.toFixed(2)} ${w}`).join("  "));

==== 2032 scripts/tts.mjs
// Offline narration with the operating system's voice (only with the user's approval — it is a
// stand-in for a real voice-over). macOS: `say` (Indonesian voice "Damayanti"). Writes an MP3 and,
// because the text is known, the word timings too.
//   node scripts/tts.mjs <script.txt> <public/audio/<id>.mp3> --words=stories/<id>/words.json [--voice=Damayanti] [--rate=170]

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";

const [scriptFile, outMp3] = process.argv.slice(2).filter((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (process.argv.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
if (!scriptFile || !outMp3) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/tts.mjs <script.txt> <out.mp3> --words=stories/<id>/words.json [--voice=Damayanti] [--rate=170]");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (process.platform !== "darwin") {
  console.error("Built-in TTS is only wired for macOS (`say`). On other systems record or generate the voice-over elsewhere and use scripts/transcribe.mjs.");
  process.exit(2);
}
const voice = opt("voice", "Damayanti"), rate = opt("rate", "170");
const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "cf-tts-"));
const aiff = path.join(tmp, "vo.aiff");
const r = spawnSync("say", ["-v", voice, "-r", rate, "-o", aiff, "-f", scriptFile], { encoding: "utf8" });
if (r.status !== 0) { console.error(r.stderr || `say failed (voice "${voice}" installed?)`); process.exit(3); }
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outMp3), { recursive: true });
spawnSync("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-i", aiff, "-af", "apad=pad_dur=0.2", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "1", "-b:a", "160k", outMp3]);
fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
console.log(`tts: ${outMp3} (${voice}, rate ${rate})`);
const words = opt("words");
if (words) {
  const t = spawnSync("node", [path.join("scripts", "transcribe.mjs"), outMp3, `--out=${words}`, `--script=${scriptFile}`], { stdio: "inherit" });
  process.exit(t.status ?? 0);
}

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame } from "remotion";

import { ComicStage } from "../engine/three/ComicStage.tsx";
import { ComicCharacter } from "../engine/three/ComicCharacter.tsx";

import { LIB } from "../engine/three/library.tsx";

import type { SetSpec, StageLook } from "../engine/three/setTypes.ts";
import { LAYOUTS, type Quad } from "../engine/panels/geometry.ts";
import { LivingPanel } from "../engine/panels/LivingPanel.tsx";
import { CaptionBox, ImpactTypography, InkBurst, ShockLines, SfxText, SpeedLines, Stamp } from "../engine/fx/ComicFx.tsx";
import { PaperTexture } from "../engine/fx/PaperTexture.tsx";

// Element catalog: one still per page, so a director (or a buyer) can SEE what exists before writing
// a story. `node scripts/stills.mjs out/catalog 0,1,2,… PanelverseCatalog` → contact sheet.

const ORTHO = { pos: [0, 0, 120] as [number, number, number], target: [0, 0, 0] as [number, number, number], fov: (2 * Math.atan(8 / 120) * 180) / Math.PI, roll: 0 };
const PX = 120; // px per world unit with ORTHO
const wx = (px: number) => (px - 540) / PX;
const wy = (py: number) => (960 - py) / PX;

/** scales + centres its children to fit a cube of `size` world units */
const Fit: React.FC<{ size: number; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ size, children }) => {
  const outer = useRef<Group>(null);
  const inner = useRef<Group>(null);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!outer.current || !inner.current) return;
    inner.current.position.set(0, 0, 0);
    outer.current.scale.setScalar(1);
    outer.current.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    const b = new Box3().setFromObject(inner.current);
    const s = b.getSize(new Vector3()), c = b.getCenter(new Vector3());
    const k = size / Math.max(s.x, s.y, s.z * 0.6, 1e-3);
    inner.current.position.set(-c.x, -c.y, -c.z);
    outer.current.scale.setScalar(k);
  });
  return (
    <group ref={outer}>
      <group ref={inner}>{children}</group>
    </group>
  );
};

const Title: React.FC<{ text: string; sub?: string }> = ({ text, sub }) => (
  <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 40, top: 40, right: 40, fontFamily: `"${FONT_IMPACT}"`, fontSize: 70, color: INK, letterSpacing: 3 }}>
    {text}
    {sub ? <div style={{ fontFamily: `"${FONT_LETTER}"`, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 30 }}>{sub}</div> : null}
  </div>
);
const Label: React.FC<{ x: number; y: number; text: string; w?: number }> = ({ x, y, text, w = 340 }) => (
  <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: x - w / 2, top: y, width: w, textAlign: "center", fontFamily: `"${FONT_LETTER}"`, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 30, color: INK, background: "rgba(246,232,200,0.85)" }}>{text}</div>
);

    ))}
  </>
