const FxPage: React.FC = () => (
  <>
    <SpeedLines f={20} from={0} to={100} opacity={0.35} />
    <InkBurst f={20} at={0} dur={100} x={540} y={520} r={330} />
    <ImpactTypography f={30} at={0} to={100} text="IMPACT!" x={540} y={520} size={150} />
    <CaptionBox f={40} at={0} to={100} text="CAPTION..." x={60} y={210} size={70} />
    <SfxText f={20} at={0} to={100} text="KRING!" x={300} y={980} size={140} />
    <Stamp f={20} at={0} to={100} text="LUNAS" x={760} y={1000} size={100} />
    <ShockLines f={20} from={0} to={100} x={540} y={1450} r={130} />
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 470, top: 1380, width: 140, height: 140, borderRadius: 70, background: "#F5CC27", border: `8px solid ${INK}` }} />
    <Label x={540} y={1640} text="fx: impact · caption · burst · speed · sfxText · stamp · shock · flood · flash · impactFrame · halftoneWipe" w={1000} />
  </>
);

export const Catalog: React.FC = () => {
  const p = useCurrentFrame();
  let page: React.ReactNode = null;
  const ip = itemPages();
  if (p < 8) page = p < ip ? <ItemsPage page={p} /> : <Title text="(no more items)" />;
  else if (p === 8) page = <LooksPage />;
  else if (p < 11) page = <ExprPage page={p - 9} />;
  else if (p < 11 + SETS.length) page = <SetPage name={SETS[p - 11]} />;
  else if (p < 13 + SETS.length) page = <StagePage page={p - 11 - SETS.length} />;
  else if (p === 13 + SETS.length) page = <LayoutsPage />;
  else page = <FxPage />;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: PAPER }}>
      <FontGate>{page}</FontGate>
      <PaperTexture />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

==== 18459 src/kits/panelverse/director/kit.ts
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PANELVERSE authoring kit — everything a story file needs, as plain TypeScript data + helpers.
//   import { … } from "../../kits/panelverse/director/kit.ts";
// Pure module (no React / no DOM): pv-make loads stories in Node to lint them and build the sound mix.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
import type { V3 } from "../engine/types.ts";
import type { CamKey, CamState } from "../engine/camera.ts";
import type { EaseName, Key } from "../engine/keyframes.ts";
import { FULL, centerOf, type PanelKey, type Pt, type Quad } from "../engine/panels/geometry.ts";
import { INK, PAPER, RED, YELLOW } from "../theme/palette.ts";
import type { Ducking, FxCue, PanelCue, SegmentType, SfxCue, StoryDef } from "./types.ts";

export * from "./types.ts";
export { LAYOUTS, FULL, PANEL0, centerOf, boundsOf, shardsOf, type Quad, type Pt, type PanelKey } from "../engine/panels/geometry.ts";
export { EXPR, STAND, NEUTRAL, type Pose, type Expr, type PoseKey, type ExprKey } from "../engine/three/rig.ts";
export { LOOKS, look, type Look } from "../engine/three/looks.ts";
export { SET_PRESETS } from "../engine/three/setPresets.ts";
export type { SetSpec, ItemSpec } from "../engine/three/setTypes.ts";
export { EASES, type Key, type EaseName } from "../engine/keyframes.ts";
export { SW, INK, PAPER, YELLOW, RED, BLUE, TEAL } from "../theme/palette.ts";
export type { V3 } from "../engine/types.ts";

export const FPS = 60;
export const S = (sec: number) => Math.round(sec * FPS);
export const CENTER: Pt = [540, 960];

// ── word clock: anchor every event to the spoken words ────────────────────────────────────────
export type Word = readonly [string, number, number, ...unknown[]];
const norm = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().normalize("NFKD").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, "");
export type Clock = ReturnType<typeof clock>;
/**
 * `const W = clock(WORDS, { offset: 0.3 })` →
 *   W.at("oke") / W.at("dia", 2)  frame where the word (its 2nd occurrence) starts
 *   W.end("tamat")                frame where it ends
 *   W.s(2.5)                      frame of a VO second · W.voEnd frame where the VO ends
 */
export const clock = (words: readonly Word[], opt: { offset?: number } = {}) => {
  const offset = opt.offset ?? 0;
  const list = words.map(([w, a, b], i) => ({ i, w, n: norm(w), a: a + offset, b: b + offset }));
  const find = (word: string, nth = 1) => {
    const n = norm(word);
    let hits = list.filter((x) => x.n === n);
    if (!hits.length) hits = list.filter((x) => x.n.startsWith(n) || (n.length > 3 && n.startsWith(x.n)));
    const hit = hits[nth - 1];
    if (!hit) {
      const near = list.filter((x) => x.n.slice(0, 2) === n.slice(0, 2)).map((x) => x.w);
      throw new Error(`word "${word}"${nth > 1 ? ` (#${nth})` : ""} not in the VO transcript${near.length ? ` — did you mean: ${[...new Set(near)].join(", ")}` : ""}`);
    }
    return hit;
  };
  return {
    words: list,
    offset,
    at: (word: string, nth = 1) => Math.round(find(word, nth).a * FPS),
    end: (word: string, nth = 1) => Math.round(find(word, nth).b * FPS),
    s: (sec: number) => Math.round((sec + offset) * FPS),
    voEnd: Math.round(((list[list.length - 1]?.b ?? 0) + 0) * FPS),
    /** speech spans (frames) merged across short pauses — drives SFX ducking */
    spans: (mergeGap = 6): [number, number][] => {
      const out: [number, number][] = [];
      for (const x of list) {
        const s0 = Math.floor(x.a * FPS), e0 = Math.ceil(x.b * FPS);
        const last = out[out.length - 1];
        if (last && s0 - last[1] <= mergeGap) last[1] = Math.max(last[1], e0);
        else out.push([s0, e0]);
      }
      return out;
    },
  };
};

// ── cameras ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const unit = (v: V3): V3 => {
  const l = Math.hypot(...v) || 1;
  return [v[0] / l, v[1] / l, v[2] / l];
};
/** Camera along `dir` from `target`, at the distance where `worldH` units fill `frac` of the canvas height. */
export const frameCam = (target: V3, dir: V3, worldH: number, frac: number, fov: number, roll = 0): CamState => {
  const d = worldH / frac / (2 * Math.tan((fov * Math.PI) / 360));
  const u = unit(dir);
  return { pos: [target[0] + u[0] * d, target[1] + u[1] * d, target[2] + u[2] * d], target, fov, roll };
};
export const camKey = (f: number, c: CamState, ease?: EaseName): CamKey => ({ f, v: c, ease });
/** Dolly zoom (vertigo): the fov changes while distance compensates so the subject keeps its size. */
export const dollyKeys = (f0: number, f1: number, target: V3, dir: V3, dist0: number, fov0: number, fov1: number, roll = 0, steps = 8): CamKey[] => {
  const k = dist0 * Math.tan((fov0 * Math.PI) / 360);
  const u = unit(dir);
  return Array.from({ length: steps + 1 }, (_, i) => {
    const t = i / steps;
    const e = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;
    const fov = fov0 + (fov1 - fov0) * e;
    const d = k / Math.tan((fov * Math.PI) / 360);
    return { f: Math.round(f0 + (f1 - f0) * t), v: { pos: [target[0] + u[0] * d, target[1] + u[1] * d, target[2] + u[2] * d] as V3, target, fov, roll }, ease: "linear" as EaseName };
  });
};
/** Orbit around a target (arc move) from angle a0 to a1 (radians, around Y), at height h and distance d. */
export const orbitKeys = (f0: number, f1: number, target: V3, d: number, h: number, a0: number, a1: number, fov = 34, steps = 6): CamKey[] =>
  Array.from({ length: steps + 1 }, (_, i) => {
    const t = i / steps;
    const e = t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2;
    const a = a0 + (a1 - a0) * e;
    return { f: Math.round(f0 + (f1 - f0) * t), v: { pos: [target[0] + Math.sin(a) * d, target[1] + h, target[2] + Math.cos(a) * d] as V3, target, fov, roll: 0 }, ease: "linear" as EaseName };
  });
/** Alternating small offsets (typing, trembling, fist shake…) as keyframes. */
export const jitterKeys = <T extends Record<string, unknown>>(f0: number, f1: number, every: number, make: (i: number) => T): Key<T>[] => {
  const out: Key<T>[] = [];
  for (let f = f0, i = 0; f <= f1; f += every, i++) out.push({ f, v: make(i), ease: "inOut" });
  return out;
};

// ── panels: build a panel's life from transition segments ─────────────────────────────────────
export type Seg = { keys: PanelKey[]; moves: { type: SegmentType; at: number }[]; contentCenter?: Pt; shatter?: PanelCue["shatter"] };
const offscreen = (dir: "left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom"): Pt => (dir === "left" ? [-1200, 0] : dir === "right" ? [1200, 0] : dir === "top" ? [0, -2000] : [0, 2000]);
const WIDE: Quad = [[-260, -40], [1340, -40], [1340, 1960], [-260, 1960]];
export const enter = {
  /** appears instantly */
  cut: (at: number, quad: Quad, border = 8): Seg => ({ keys: [{ f: at, v: { pts: quad, border, scale: 1, rot: 0, move: [0, 0], iris: 0 } }], moves: [{ type: "cut", at }] }),
  /** slams onto the page (zoom-in overshoot, or flying in from a side) */
  slam: (at: number, quad: Quad, from: "zoom" | "left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom" = "zoom", dur = 10, border = 9): Seg => {
    const m: Pt = from === "zoom" ? [0, -50] : [offscreen(from)[0] * 0.08, offscreen(from)[1] * 0.04];
    return {
      keys: [
        { f: at, v: { pts: quad, border, scale: from === "zoom" ? 1.4 : 1.12, rot: (from === "left" ? -7 : 7), move: m, iris: 0 } },
        { f: at + dur, v: { scale: 1, rot: 0, move: [0, 0] }, ease: "outBackBig" },
      ],
      moves: [{ type: "slam", at: at + Math.round(dur * 0.35) }],
    };
  },
  /** slides in from off-screen */
  slide: (at: number, quad: Quad, from: "left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom" = "right", dur = 14, border = 9): Seg => ({
    keys: [
      { f: at, v: { pts: quad, border, scale: 1, rot: from === "left" ? -4 : 4, move: offscreen(from), iris: 0 } },
      { f: at + dur, v: { move: [0, 0], rot: 0 }, ease: "expoOut" },
    ],
    moves: [{ type: "slide", at }],
  }),
  /** opens as a circle from its centre (iris in) */
  iris: (at: number, quad: Quad, dur = 16, r = 1250, border = 10): Seg => ({
    keys: [
      { f: at, v: { pts: quad, border, iris: 1, scale: 1, rot: 0, move: [0, 0] } },
      { f: at + dur, v: { iris: r }, ease: "inOut" },
      { f: at + dur + 1, v: { iris: 0 }, ease: "hold" },
    ],
    moves: [{ type: "iris", at }],
  }),
  /** slashes in diagonally from a side: a half-screen split for `hold` frames, then takes the whole frame */
  slash: (at: number, from: "left" | "right" = "right", hold = 6, border = 12): Seg => {
    const s = from === "right" ? 1 : -1;
    const P = (x0: number, x1: number, sk: number): Quad =>
      s > 0 ? [[x0, -40], [x1, -40], [x1 - 0, 1960], [x0 - sk, 1960]] : [[1080 - x1, -40], [1080 - x0, -40], [1080 - x0 + sk, 1960], [1080 - x1, 1960]];
    return {
      keys: [
        { f: at, v: { pts: P(1150, 1750, 200), border, scale: 1, rot: 0, move: [0, 0], iris: 0 } },
        { f: at + 8, v: { pts: P(600, 1340, 220) }, ease: "expoOut" },
        { f: at + 8 + hold, v: { pts: P(600, 1340, 220) } },
        { f: at + 15 + hold, v: { pts: WIDE, border: 0 }, ease: "expoOut" },
      ],
      moves: [{ type: "slash", at }],
      contentCenter: [540, 960],
    };
  },
};
export const move = {
  /** grows to full screen (or to `to`) — the camera inside should push in at the same time */
  expand: (at: number, dur = 20, to: Quad = FULL): Seg => ({ keys: [{ f: at, v: {} }, { f: at + dur, v: { pts: to, border: to === FULL ? 0 : 9, rot: 0, scale: 1 }, ease: "inOut" }], moves: [{ type: "expand", at }] }),
  /** shrinks into a printed panel (freeze frames, endings) */
  collapse: (at: number, to: Quad, dur = 14, rot = -1, border = 11): Seg => ({ keys: [{ f: at, v: {} }, { f: at + dur, v: { pts: to, border, rot }, ease: "outBack" }], moves: [{ type: "collapse", at }] }),
  /** falls off the page */
  fall: (at: number, dur = 22, dir: "down" | "left" | "right" = "down", rot = 14): Seg => ({
    keys: [{ f: at, v: {} }, { f: at + dur, v: { move: dir === "down" ? [rot * 9, 1500] : dir === "left" ? [-1300, 300] : [1300, 300], rot }, ease: "in" }],
    moves: [{ type: "fall", at }],
  }),
  /** slow living drift of a panel on the page */
  drift: (at: number, dur: number, m: Pt = [0, -14], rot = 0.8): Seg => ({ keys: [{ f: at, v: {} }, { f: at + dur, v: { move: m, rot }, ease: "inOut" }], moves: [{ type: "drift", at }] }),
  /** punch the whole panel bigger (zoom) */
  zoom: (at: number, dur = 10, scale = 1.12): Seg => ({ keys: [{ f: at, v: {} }, { f: at + dur, v: { scale }, ease: "outBack" }], moves: [{ type: "zoom", at }] }),
  /** closes as a circle (iris out) to radius r (0 = gone) */
  irisOut: (at: number, dur = 16, r = 0, center?: Pt): Seg => ({ keys: [{ f: at, v: { iris: 1300 } }, { f: at + dur, v: { iris: Math.max(1, r) }, ease: "inOut" }], moves: [{ type: "iris", at }], contentCenter: center }),
  /** breaks into flying shards (the shot freezes at `at`) */
  shatter: (at: number, dur = 30, impact: Pt = [560, 980], cuts = [0.06, 0.29, 0.5, 0.77]): Seg => ({ keys: [], moves: [{ type: "shatter", at }], shatter: { at, dur, impact, cuts } }),
};
/** Assemble a panel cue from segments: `panel("rage", 349, 507, enter.slam(349, P1), move.expand(428), …)` */
export const panel = (shot: string, from: number, to: number, ...segs: Seg[]): PanelCue => {
  const keys = segs.flatMap((s) => s.keys).sort((a, b) => a.f - b.f);
  return {
    shot,
    from,
    to,
    geom: keys.length ? keys : [{ f: from, v: { pts: FULL, border: 0 } }],
    contentCenter: segs.find((s) => s.contentCenter)?.contentCenter,
    shatter: segs.find((s) => s.shatter)?.shatter,
    moves: segs.flatMap((s) => s.moves),
    shadow: true,
  };
};
export { centerOf as panelCenter };

// ── comic FX ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const fx = {
  impact: (at: number, to: number, text: string, o: { x?: number; y?: number; size?: number; rot?: number; fill?: string; font?: "impact" | "title" } = {}): FxCue => ({
    kind: "impact", at, to, text, x: o.x ?? 540, y: o.y ?? 340, size: o.size ?? 160, rot: o.rot ?? -6, fill: o.fill ?? YELLOW, font: o.font,
  }),
  caption: (at: number, to: number, text: string, o: { x?: number; y?: number; size?: number; fill?: string } = {}): FxCue => ({ kind: "caption", at, to, text, x: o.x ?? 64, y: o.y ?? 236, size: o.size ?? 84, fill: o.fill }),
  burst: (at: number, dur: number, o: { x?: number; y?: number; r?: number; fill?: string; inner?: string; seed?: number } = {}): FxCue => ({ kind: "burst", at, dur, x: o.x ?? 540, y: o.y ?? 900, r: o.r ?? 420, fill: o.fill ?? PAPER, inner: o.inner ?? RED, seed: o.seed }),
  speed: (from: number, to: number, o: { cx?: number; cy?: number; inner?: number; opacity?: number; color?: string } = {}): FxCue => ({ kind: "speed", from, to, ...o }),
  flood: (at: number, dur: number, to: number, origins: Pt[] = [[540, 1500], [120, 300], [980, 520]]): FxCue => ({ kind: "flood", at, dur, to, origins }),
  flash: (at: number, dur = 3, color = PAPER): FxCue => ({ kind: "flash", at, dur, color }),
  sfxText: (at: number, to: number, text: string, o: { x?: number; y?: number; size?: number; rot?: number; fill?: string } = {}): FxCue => ({ kind: "sfxText", at, to, text, x: o.x ?? 540, y: o.y ?? 600, size: o.size ?? 130, rot: o.rot ?? 8, fill: o.fill ?? RED }),
  impactFrame: (at: number, dur = 3): FxCue => ({ kind: "impactFrame", at, dur }),
  stamp: (at: number, to: number, text: string, o: { x?: number; y?: number; size?: number; rot?: number; color?: string } = {}): FxCue => ({ kind: "stamp", at, to, text, x: o.x ?? 540, y: o.y ?? 1180, size: o.size ?? 110, rot: o.rot ?? -12, color: o.color ?? RED }),
  shock: (from: number, to: number, x: number, y: number, r = 150): FxCue => ({ kind: "shock", from, to, x, y, r }),
  halftoneWipe: (at: number, dur: number, to: number, o: { color?: string; reverse?: boolean } = {}): FxCue => ({ kind: "halftoneWipe", at, dur, to, color: o.color ?? INK, reverse: o.reverse }),
};

// ── sound ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const sfx = (name: string, at: number, volume: number, o: { duck?: number; until?: number } = {}): SfxCue => ({ at, src: `sfx/pv-${name}.wav`, volume, ...o });
const MOVE_SOUND: Partial<Record<SegmentType, [string, number]>> = {
  slam: ["slam", 0.34], slide: ["whooshShort", 0.3], iris: ["whoosh", 0.3], expand: ["whooshShort", 0.36], collapse: ["whooshShort", 0.28],
  fall: ["whoosh", 0.22], slash: ["swish", 0.5], shatter: ["bigShatter", 0.55], zoom: ["pop", 0.2], flip: ["tick", 0.25],
};
/**
 * Automatic sound for a story: every transition and comic FX gets its effect (placed on the event
 * frame), plus the story's own `sfx`. Loud hits should sit in VO pauses — the ducking handles the rest.
 */
export const soundsFor = (st: StoryDef): SfxCue[] => {
  const out: SfxCue[] = [];
  if (st.autoSfx !== false) {
    for (const p of st.panels) for (const m of p.moves ?? []) {
      const s = MOVE_SOUND[m.type];
      if (s) out.push(sfx(s[0], Math.max(0, m.at), s[1], m.type === "shatter" ? {} : { duck: 0.8 }));
    }
    for (const c of st.fx) {
      if (c.kind === "impact") out.push(sfx("punchDry", c.at + 1, 0.3, { duck: 0.4 }));
      else if (c.kind === "caption") out.push(sfx("tick", c.at + 2, 0.24));
      else if (c.kind === "burst") out.push(sfx("boom", c.at, 0.45, { duck: 0.6 }));
      else if (c.kind === "flood") [0, 0.25, 0.5].forEach((k, i) => out.push(sfx("splat", Math.round(c.at + c.dur * k), 0.45 - i * 0.05, { until: c.to })));
      else if (c.kind === "sfxText") out.push(sfx("hit", c.at, 0.3, { duck: 0.6 }));
      else if (c.kind === "impactFrame") out.push(sfx("punch", c.at, 0.34, { duck: 0.6 }));
      else if (c.kind === "stamp") out.push(sfx("stamp", c.at + 2, 0.45));
      else if (c.kind === "shock") out.push(sfx("freeze", c.from, 0.3, { duck: 0.8 }));
      else if (c.kind === "halftoneWipe") out.push(sfx("cloud", c.at, 0.25, { until: c.to }));
    }
  }
  out.push(...(st.sfx ?? []));
  out.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at);
  // the same sound twice within 6 frames reads as a glitch: keep the first
  return out.filter((c, i) => !out.slice(0, i).some((p) => p.src === c.src && c.at - p.at < 6));
};
export const duckGain = (d: Ducking, f: number) => {
  let g = 1;
  for (const [s, e] of d.spans) {
    let k = 0;
    if (f >= s && f <= e) k = 1;
    else if (f < s && f > s - d.attack) k = 1 - (s - f) / d.attack;
    else if (f > e && f < e + d.release) k = 1 - (f - e) / d.release;
    g = Math.min(g, 1 - (1 - d.level) * k);
  }
  return g;
};

// ── story() — fills defaults so a story file stays short ──────────────────────────────────────
export const story = (s: Omit<StoryDef, "fps" | "page" | "duck"> & { page?: Partial<StoryDef["page"]>; clock?: Clock; duck?: Ducking }): StoryDef => {
  const { clock: W, ...rest } = s;
  return {
    ...rest,
    fps: 60,
    autoSfx: s.autoSfx ?? true,
    page: { bg: PAPER, cam: [{ f: 0, v: { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, rot: 0, tiltX: 0, tiltY: 0 } }], shakes: [], ...s.page },
    duck: s.duck ?? (W ? { spans: W.spans(), level: 0.3, attack: 4, release: 10 } : undefined),
  };
};

==== 11364 src/kits/panelverse/director/lint.ts
// Story lint: validity + safe-zone + anti-monotony rules, run by scripts/pv-make.mjs before rendering.
// Pure TS (Node + browser). Errors stop the make; warnings are printed for the director to judge.
import { samplePanel, boundsOf } from "../engine/panels/geometry.ts";
import { sampleCam } from "../engine/camera.ts";
import type { StoryDef } from "./types.ts";

export type LintContext = { voEndFrame: number; items: string[]; props: string[] };
export type LintResult = { errors: string[]; warnings: string[]; stats: Record<string, string | number> };

const sec = (f: number) => `${(f / 60).toFixed(1)} s`;
const TEXT_W: Record<string, number> = { impact: 0.46, title: 0.6, sfxText: 0.52, stamp: 0.62, caption: 0.5 };

/** what the viewer sees at frame f, reduced to a layout signature */
const signature = (st: StoryDef, f: number) => {
  const vis = st.panels.filter((p) => f >= p.from && f <= (p.shatter ? Math.max(p.to, p.shatter.at + p.shatter.dur) : p.to));
  if (!vis.length) return "empty";
  const parts = vis.map((p) => {
    const g = samplePanel(p.geom, f);
    const b = boundsOf(g.pts);
    const area = (Math.min(b.x1, 1080) - Math.max(b.x0, 0)) * (Math.min(b.y1, 1920) - Math.max(b.y0, 0)) * g.scale * g.scale;
    return area / (1080 * 1920);
  }).filter((a) => a > 0.02);
  const full = parts.filter((a) => a > 0.92).length;
  const small = parts.length - full;
  if (full && small) return "full+inset";
  if (full) return "full";
  return small === 1 ? "page-1" : `page-${Math.min(small, 4)}`;
};

export const lintStory = (st: StoryDef, ctx: LintContext): LintResult => {
  const E: string[] = [], W: string[] = [];
  const D = st.durationInFrames;
  // ── basics ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(st.id)) E.push(`id "${st.id}" must use only a-z, 0-9 and "-"`);
  if (D < ctx.voEndFrame + 12) E.push(`durationInFrames ${D} (${sec(D)}) ends before / right on the VO end ${sec(ctx.voEndFrame)} — the narration would be cut`);
  if (D > ctx.voEndFrame + 300) W.push(`${sec(D - ctx.voEndFrame)} after the VO ends — keep the closing hold under ~3 s`);
  // ── references ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const shotIds = Object.keys(st.shots);
  const items = new Set([...ctx.items, ...(st.elements ?? [])]);
  const props = new Set(ctx.props);
  for (const p of st.panels) {
    if (!st.shots[p.shot]) E.push(`panel uses unknown shot "${p.shot}" (shots: ${shotIds.join(", ")})`);
    if (p.to <= p.from) E.push(`panel "${p.shot}" ends (${p.to}) before it starts (${p.from})`);
    if (!p.geom.length) E.push(`panel "${p.shot}" has no geometry keys`);
  }
  for (const id of shotIds) if (!st.panels.some((p) => p.shot === id)) W.push(`shot "${id}" is never shown in a panel`);
  for (const [id, s] of Object.entries(st.shots)) {
    if (!s.camera.length) E.push(`shot "${id}" has no camera keys`);
    for (const it of s.set.items ?? []) if (!items.has(it.type)) E.push(`shot "${id}": set item "${it.type}" is not a library item or a declared story element`);
    const allProps = [...(s.props ?? []), ...s.actors.flatMap((a) => [...(a.torso ?? []), ...(a.head ?? []), ...(a.heldR ? [a.heldR] : []), ...(a.heldL ? [a.heldL] : [])])];
    for (const p of allProps) {
      if (!props.has(p.kind)) E.push(`shot "${id}": prop kind "${p.kind}" does not exist (${[...props].join(", ")})`);
      if (p.kind === "item") for (const k of p.keys) if (k.v.type && !items.has(String(k.v.type))) E.push(`shot "${id}": item prop "${k.v.type}" is not a library item or declared element`);
    }
    for (const a of s.actors) if (!st.cast[a.cast]) E.push(`shot "${id}": actor "${a.cast}" is not in cast (${Object.keys(st.cast).join(", ")})`);
  }
  // ── custom elements ("think up elements for THIS script") ────────────────────────────────
  const used = new Set<string>();
  for (const s of Object.values(st.shots)) {
    for (const it of s.set.items ?? []) used.add(it.type);
    for (const p of [...(s.props ?? []), ...s.actors.flatMap((a) => [...(a.torso ?? []), ...(a.head ?? []), ...(a.heldR ? [a.heldR] : []), ...(a.heldL ? [a.heldL] : [])])])
      if (p.kind === "item") for (const k of p.keys) if (k.v.type) used.add(String(k.v.type));
  }
  if (!st.elements?.length) E.push("no story elements: design at least one element for this script in elements.tsx (registerItems) and list it in story.elements");
  for (const el of st.elements ?? []) if (!used.has(el)) W.push(`story element "${el}" is declared but never placed`);
  // ── beat sheet ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const beats = st.beats ?? [];
  const minBeats = Math.max(3, Math.floor(D / 60 / 3.5));
  if (beats.length < minBeats) E.push(`beat sheet has ${beats.length} beats — write at least ${minBeats} (one per 2–3.5 s of VO, each with words, idea and device)`);
  const devices = new Set(beats.map((b) => b.device.toLowerCase()));
  if (beats.length && devices.size < Math.min(4, beats.length)) E.push(`only ${devices.size} different devices in the beat sheet — vary them (${[...devices].join(", ")})`);
  for (let i = 1; i < beats.length; i++) if (beats[i].device.toLowerCase() === beats[i - 1].device.toLowerCase()) W.push(`beats ${i} and ${i + 1} use the same device "${beats[i].device}"`);
  // ── variety: layouts / transitions / fx ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const sigTime: Record<string, number> = {};
  let empty = 0, emptyRun = 0;
  for (let f = 0; f < D; f += 6) {
    const s = signature(st, f);
    sigTime[s] = (sigTime[s] ?? 0) + 6;
    if (s === "empty") { emptyRun += 6; empty = Math.max(empty, emptyRun); } else emptyRun = 0;
  }
  const layouts = Object.entries(sigTime).filter(([k, t]) => k !== "empty" && t >= 24).map(([k]) => k);
  if (D > 600 && layouts.length < 3) E.push(`only ${layouts.length} screen layout(s) (${layouts.join(", ")}) — use at least 3 (full-bleed, a 2–4 panel page, an inset, a printed page…)`);
  if (empty > 30) W.push(`${sec(empty)} with no panel on screen (blank page)`);
  const moves = st.panels.flatMap((p) => p.moves ?? []).filter((m) => m.type !== "cut" && m.type !== "drift").sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at);
  const moveTypes = new Set(moves.map((m) => m.type));
  if (D > 600 && moveTypes.size < 3) E.push(`only ${moveTypes.size} transition type(s) (${[...moveTypes].join(", ")}) — use at least 3 different panel moves`);
  for (let i = 2; i < moves.length; i++) if (moves[i].type === moves[i - 1].type && moves[i].type === moves[i - 2].type && moves[i].at - moves[i - 2].at > 30) W.push(`three "${moves[i].type}" transitions in a row (${sec(moves[i - 2].at)}–${sec(moves[i].at)})`);
  const fxKinds = new Set(st.fx.map((c) => c.kind));
  if (D > 600 && fxKinds.size < 3) W.push(`only ${fxKinds.size} kinds of comic FX — mix lettering, bursts, speed lines, captions, stamps, shock lines…`);
  // ── lettering ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const texts = st.fx.filter((c) => c.kind === "impact" || c.kind === "sfxText" || c.kind === "stamp" || c.kind === "caption") as Extract<StoryDef["fx"][number], { text: string }>[];
  const bigText = texts.filter((c) => c.kind !== "caption");
  if (bigText.length > Math.max(3, Math.ceil(D / 60 / 2.5))) W.push(`${bigText.length} lettering hits in ${sec(D)} — more than one per 2.5 s turns into a slideshow of words`);
  for (const c of texts) {
    const words = c.text.trim().split(/\s+/).length;
    if (words > 3 && c.kind !== "caption") W.push(`"${c.text}" is ${words} words — impact lettering reads best at 1–3 words`);
    const size = "size" in c && c.size ? c.size : 84;
    const k = c.kind === "impact" && "font" in c && c.font === "title" ? TEXT_W.title : TEXT_W[c.kind] ?? 0.55;
    const w = c.text.length * size * k + (c.kind === "caption" ? 80 : 0);
    const x0 = c.kind === "caption" ? c.x : c.x - w / 2, x1 = c.kind === "caption" ? c.x + w : c.x + w / 2;
    if (x0 < 50 || x1 > 1030) E.push(`"${c.text}" (${c.kind} at ${sec(c.at)}) is ≈${Math.round(w)} px wide and leaves the frame (${Math.round(x0)}–${Math.round(x1)}) — smaller size or shorter text`);
    else if (x1 > 920 && c.kind !== "caption") W.push(`"${c.text}" reaches x=${Math.round(x1)} — TikTok/Reels buttons sit on the right edge (keep ≤ 920)`);
    if (c.y < 200 || c.y > 1480) E.push(`"${c.text}" at y=${c.y} is outside the mobile safe zone (200–1480)`);
  }
  // ── pacing: long static stretches ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  for (let f0 = 0; f0 + 270 < D; f0 += 30) {
    const sig = signature(st, f0);
    if (sig !== "full") continue;
    const p = st.panels.find((x) => f0 >= x.from && f0 <= x.to && signature(st, f0) === "full");
    if (!p) continue;
    const s = st.shots[p.shot];
    const a = sampleCam(s.camera, f0 - s.start), b = sampleCam(s.camera, f0 + 270 - s.start);
    const move = Math.hypot(a.pos[0] - b.pos[0], a.pos[1] - b.pos[1], a.pos[2] - b.pos[2]) + Math.abs(a.fov - b.fov) * 0.05;
    const sameShot = st.panels.filter((x) => x.from <= f0 + 270 && x.to >= f0).length === 1;
    const fxNear = st.fx.some((c) => ("at" in c ? c.at : c.from) > f0 && ("at" in c ? c.at : c.from) < f0 + 270);
    if (sameShot && move < 0.05 && !fxNear) { W.push(`static: one full-screen shot with no camera move and no FX for 4.5 s from ${sec(f0)}`); break; }
  }
  const shotsShown = new Set(st.panels.map((p) => p.shot)).size;
  if (shotsShown < Math.min(4, Math.ceil(D / 60 / 4))) W.push(`only ${shotsShown} shots for ${sec(D)} — a new picture every 3–4 s keeps a comic alive`);
  const setPrints = new Set(Object.values(st.shots).map((s) => JSON.stringify([s.set.kind, s.set.look, s.set.wall, s.set.floor, s.set.time, (s.set.items ?? []).map((i) => i.type).sort()])));
  if (shotIds.length > 2 && setPrints.size < 2) W.push("every shot uses the same set — change place, stage look or colours between beats");
  return {
    errors: E,
    warnings: W,
    stats: {
      duration: sec(D),
      shots: shotIds.length,
      panels: st.panels.length,
      layouts: layouts.join(" · "),
      transitions: [...moveTypes].join(" · "),
      fx: [...fxKinds].join(" · "),
      beats: beats.length,
      devices: [...devices].join(" · "),
      elements: (st.elements ?? []).join(" · "),
      lettering: texts.map((t) => t.text).join(" · "),
    },
  };
};

==== 6548 src/kits/panelverse/director/ShotRenderer.tsx
import React from "react";
import { ComicStage, sampleCam } from "../engine/three/ComicStage.tsx";
import { ComicCharacter } from "../engine/three/ComicCharacter.tsx";
import { samplePose, sampleExpr } from "../engine/three/rig.ts";
import { SetRenderer, PlacedItem, setAnchors } from "../engine/three/sets.tsx";
import { ChatBubble3D, Phone, Sign, type BubbleContent, type PhoneScreen } from "../engine/three/props.tsx";
import { BaksoBowl, BreakingHeart, BuzzArcs, FloatingHearts, ImpactStar, ShatterBubble, Spoon, SteamPuffs, SteamWisps, ThoughtCloud, ThoughtTrail } from "../engine/three/storyProps.tsx";
import type { V3 } from "../engine/types.ts";
import { sample, shake } from "../engine/keyframes.ts";
import type { Look } from "../engine/three/looks.ts";
import type { SetSpec } from "../engine/three/setTypes.ts";
import type { PropSpec, ShotDef } from "./types.ts";
import type { SwatchKey } from "../theme/palette.ts";

type Params = Record<string, unknown>;
const n = (v: unknown, d = 0) => (typeof v === "number" ? v : d);
const v3 = (v: unknown, d: V3 = [0, 0, 0]): V3 => (Array.isArray(v) ? (v as V3) : d);
const sc = (v: unknown, d = 1): number | V3 => (Array.isArray(v) ? (v as V3) : n(v, d));

/** Prop kinds usable in shots (`props`, actor `torso` / `head` / `heldR` / `heldL`). */
export const PROPS: Record<string, (p: Params, f: number) => React.ReactNode> = {
  /** any library item or story element, animated: { type, pos, rot, scale, sw, sw2, text, on, n } */
  item: (p, f) => <PlacedItem spec={{ type: String(p.type), pos: v3(p.pos), rot: p.rot as V3 | number | undefined, scale: sc(p.scale), sw: p.sw as SwatchKey, sw2: p.sw2 as SwatchKey, text: p.text as string, sub: p.sub as string, on: Boolean(p.on), n: p.n as number, t: p.t as number }} f={f} />,
  phone: (p) => <Phone screen={(p.screen as PhoneScreen) ?? { kind: "off" }} case={(p.case as SwatchKey) ?? "red"} position={v3(p.pos)} rotation={v3(p.rot)} scale={n(p.scale, 1)} />,
  bubble: (p) =>
    n(p.scale, 1) > 0.001 ? (
      <ChatBubble3D w={n(p.w, 0.5)} h={n(p.h, 0.3)} tail={(p.tail as "left" | "right" | "none") ?? "left"} fill={p.fill as string | undefined} content={p.content as BubbleContent} position={v3(p.pos)} rotation={v3(p.rot)} scale={n(p.scale, 1)} opacity={n(p.opacity, 1)} />
    ) : null,
  shatterBubble: (p) => <ShatterBubble w={n(p.w, 0.5)} h={n(p.h, 0.3)} tail={(p.tail as "left" | "right") ?? "left"} fill={p.fill as string | undefined} content={p.content as BubbleContent} position={v3(p.pos)} rotation={v3(p.rot)} scale={n(p.scale, 1)} t={n(p.t)} />,
  sign: (p) => (n(p.scale, 1) > 0.001 ? <Sign text={String(p.text ?? "")} sub={p.sub as string} w={n(p.w, 1)} h={n(p.h, 0.4)} sw={(p.sw as SwatchKey) ?? "paper"} font={(p.font as "impact" | "letter") ?? "impact"} position={v3(p.pos)} rotation={v3(p.rot)} scale={n(p.scale, 1)} /> : null),
  thoughtCloud: (p, f) => <ThoughtCloud position={v3(p.pos)} scale={n(p.scale)} f={f} />,
  thoughtTrail: (p, f) => <ThoughtTrail from={v3(p.from)} to={v3(p.to)} f={f} at={n(p.at)} />,
  steam: (p, f) => <SteamPuffs origin={v3(p.pos)} f={f} count={n(p.count, 4)} spread={n(p.spread, 0.35)} size={n(p.size, 0.12) * n(p.amount, 1)} rise={n(p.rise, 0.9)} period={n(p.period, 48)} />,
  wisps: (p, f) => <SteamWisps origin={v3(p.pos)} f={f} count={n(p.count, 3)} height={n(p.height, 0.12)} />,
  heart: (p, f) => <BreakingHeart position={v3(p.pos)} scale={n(p.scale, 0.3)} crack={n(p.crack)} split={n(p.split)} f={f} />,
  bowl: (p, f) => <BaksoBowl position={v3(p.pos)} f={f} balls={n(p.balls, 4)} />,
  spoon: (p) => (
    <group position={v3(p.pos)} rotation={v3(p.rot)}>
      <Spoon withBakso={Boolean(p.bakso)} />
    </group>
  ),
  hearts: (p, f) => <FloatingHearts origin={v3(p.pos)} f={f} at={n(p.at)} />,
  buzz: (p, f) => <BuzzArcs position={v3(p.pos)} rotation={v3(p.rot)} on={p.on !== false} f={f} />,
  impactStar: (p) => <ImpactStar position={v3(p.pos)} scale={n(p.scale)} rot={n(p.rot)} />,
};
export const PROP_KINDS = Object.keys(PROPS);

const renderProp = (spec: PropSpec, f: number, key: React.Key) => {
  if (spec.from !== undefined && f < spec.from) return null;
  if (spec.to !== undefined && f > spec.to) return null;
  const make = PROPS[spec.kind];
  if (!make) throw new Error(`PANELVERSE: unknown prop kind "${spec.kind}" (use one of ${PROP_KINDS.join(", ")}, or kind "item" with a registered element)`);
  return <React.Fragment key={key}>{make(sample<Params>(spec.keys, f), f)}</React.Fragment>;
};

export const shotLocalFrame = (shot: ShotDef, globalFrame: number) => {
  const f = Math.max(0, globalFrame - shot.start);
  return shot.freezeAt !== undefined ? Math.min(f, shot.freezeAt) : f;
};

/** Renders a ShotDef as a live ComicStage at the given global frame. */
export const ShotRenderer: React.FC<{ shot: ShotDef; cast: Record<string, Look>; frame: number }> = ({ shot, cast, frame }) => {
  const f = shotLocalFrame(shot, frame);
  const cam = sampleCam(shot.camera, f);
  const sh: V3 = [0, 0, 0];
  for (const s of shot.shakes ?? []) {
    sh[0] += shake(f, s.at, s.dur, s.amp, s.seed ?? 1);
    sh[1] += shake(f, s.at, s.dur, s.amp * 0.8, (s.seed ?? 1) + 7);
  }
  const set: SetSpec = shot.setKeys ? { ...shot.set, ...sample<Partial<SetSpec>>(shot.setKeys, f) } : shot.set;
  const anchors = setAnchors(set);
  return (
    <ComicStage width={1080} height={1920} frame={f} cam={cam} shake={sh} bg={shot.bg} light={shot.light} ink={shot.ink ?? 1.15}>
      <SetRenderer set={set} f={f} />
      {shot.actors.map((a, i) => {
        const look = cast[a.cast];
        if (!look) throw new Error(`PANELVERSE: actor "${a.cast}" is not in story.cast`);
        const body = (
          <ComicCharacter
            key={i}
            look={look}
            pose={samplePose(a.pose, f)}
            expr={sampleExpr(a.expr, f)}
            shadow={a.shadow ?? true}
            torsoExtras={a.torso?.map((p, k) => renderProp(p, f, k))}
            headExtras={a.head?.map((p, k) => renderProp(p, f, k))}
            heldR={a.heldR ? renderProp(a.heldR, f, "hr") : undefined}
            heldL={a.heldL ? renderProp(a.heldL, f, "hl") : undefined}
            holdRotR={a.holdRotR}
            holdRotL={a.holdRotL}
          />
        );
        const an = a.anchor ? anchors[a.anchor] : undefined;
        return an ? (
          <group key={i} position={an.pos} rotation={an.rot}>
            {body}
          </group>
        ) : (
          body
        );
      })}
      {shot.props?.map((p, i) => renderProp(p, f, i))}
    </ComicStage>
  );
};

==== 5216 src/kits/panelverse/director/StoryPlayer.tsx
import React from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill, Audio, staticFile, useCurrentFrame } from "remotion";
import { ShotRenderer } from "./ShotRenderer.tsx";
import { LivingPanel, PageCamera, PanelShard } from "../engine/panels/LivingPanel.tsx";
import { PAGECAM0, centerOf, samplePanel, shardsOf, type PageCam, type Pt } from "../engine/panels/geometry.ts";
import { CaptionBox, Flash, HalftoneWipe, ImpactFrame, ImpactTypography, InkBurst, InkFlood, ShockLines, SpeedLines, SfxText, Stamp } from "../engine/fx/ComicFx.tsx";
import { PaperTexture } from "../engine/fx/PaperTexture.tsx";
import { FontGate } from "../engine/FontGate.tsx";
import { RenderScaleCtx } from "../engine/three/Toon.tsx";
import { EASES, clamp, hash, sample, shake } from "../engine/keyframes.ts";
import type { FxCue, PanelCue, StoryDef } from "./types.ts";

const renderPanel = (story: StoryDef, cue: PanelCue, f: number, key: React.Key) => {
  const end = cue.shatter ? Math.max(cue.to, cue.shatter.at + cue.shatter.dur) : cue.to;
  if (f < cue.from || f > end) return null;
  const shot = story.shots[cue.shot];
  if (!shot) throw new Error(`PANELVERSE: panel uses unknown shot "${cue.shot}"`);
  const geom = samplePanel(cue.geom, f);
  const cc: Pt = cue.contentCenter ?? centerOf(geom.pts);
  if (cue.shatter && f >= cue.shatter.at) {
    const t = (f - cue.shatter.at) / cue.shatter.dur;
    if (t > 1) return null;
    const k = EASES.in(clamp(t));
    const sh = cue.shatter;
    return (
      <React.Fragment key={key}>
        {shardsOf(geom.pts, sh.impact, sh.cuts).map((pts, i) => {
          const c = centerOf(pts);
          const dx = c[0] - sh.impact[0], dy = c[1] - sh.impact[1];
          const l = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
          const pop = EASES.out(clamp(t * 3)) * 26;
          return (
            <PanelShard key={i} pts={pts} contentCenter={cc} move={[(dx / l) * (pop + k * 1100), (dy / l) * (pop + k * 700) + k * k * 900]} rot={hash(i * 3.3 + 1) * 6 * EASES.out(clamp(t * 3)) + hash(i * 1.7) * 55 * k}>
              <ShotRenderer shot={shot} cast={story.cast} frame={sh.at} />
            </PanelShard>
          );
        })}
      </React.Fragment>
    );
  }
  return (
    <LivingPanel key={key} geom={geom} contentCenter={cc} dropShadow={cue.shadow ?? true}>
      <ShotRenderer shot={shot} cast={story.cast} frame={f} />
    </LivingPanel>
  );
};

const renderFx = (c: FxCue, f: number, key: React.Key) => {
  switch (c.kind) {
    case "impact":
      return <ImpactTypography key={key} f={f} at={c.at} to={c.to} text={c.text} x={c.x} y={c.y} size={c.size} rot={c.rot} fill={c.fill} font={c.font} />;
    case "caption":
      return <CaptionBox key={key} f={f} at={c.at} to={c.to} text={c.text} x={c.x} y={c.y} size={c.size} fill={c.fill} />;
    case "burst":
      return <InkBurst key={key} f={f} at={c.at} dur={c.dur} x={c.x} y={c.y} r={c.r} fill={c.fill} inner={c.inner} seed={c.seed} spikes={16} />;
    case "speed":
      return <SpeedLines key={key} f={f} from={c.from} to={c.to} cx={c.cx} cy={c.cy} inner={c.inner} opacity={c.opacity} color={c.color} />;
    case "flood":
      return <InkFlood key={key} f={f} at={c.at} dur={c.dur} to={c.to} origins={c.origins} />;
    case "flash":
      return <Flash key={key} f={f} at={c.at} dur={c.dur} color={c.color} />;
    case "sfxText":
      return <SfxText key={key} f={f} at={c.at} to={c.to} text={c.text} x={c.x} y={c.y} size={c.size} rot={c.rot} fill={c.fill} />;
    case "impactFrame":
      return <ImpactFrame key={key} f={f} at={c.at} dur={c.dur} />;
    case "stamp":
      return <Stamp key={key} f={f} at={c.at} to={c.to} text={c.text} x={c.x} y={c.y} size={c.size} rot={c.rot} color={c.color} />;
    case "shock":
      return <ShockLines key={key} f={f} from={c.from} to={c.to} x={c.x} y={c.y} r={c.r} />;
    case "halftoneWipe":
      return <HalftoneWipe key={key} f={f} at={c.at} dur={c.dur} to={c.to} color={c.color} reverse={c.reverse} />;
  }
};

/** Plays any StoryDef. `step` = story frames per composition frame (2 for a 30 fps preview). */
export const StoryPlayer: React.FC<{ story: StoryDef; step?: number; scale?: number; audio?: string }> = ({ story, step = 1, scale = 1, audio }) => {
  const f = useCurrentFrame() * step;
  const cam: PageCam = { ...PAGECAM0, ...sample<Partial<PageCam>>(story.page.cam, f) };
  let sx = 0, sy = 0;
  story.page.shakes.forEach((s, i) => {
    sx += shake(f, s.at, s.dur, s.amp, 20 + i);
    sy += shake(f, s.at, s.dur, s.amp, 40 + i);
  });
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: story.page.bg, overflow: "hidden" }}>
      {audio ? <Audio src={staticFile(audio)} /> : null}
      <RenderScaleCtx.Provider value={scale}>
        <AbsoluteFill style={{ width: 1080, height: 1920, transform: `scale(${scale})`, transformOrigin: "0 0" }}>
          <FontGate>
            <AbsoluteFill style={{ transform: `translate(${sx}px, ${sy}px)` }}>
              <PageCamera cam={cam}>{story.panels.map((p, i) => renderPanel(story, p, f, i))}</PageCamera>
              {story.fx.map((c, i) => renderFx(c, f, i))}
            </AbsoluteFill>
          </FontGate>
          <PaperTexture />
        </AbsoluteFill>
      </RenderScaleCtx.Provider>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

==== 4179 src/kits/panelverse/director/types.ts
// The PANELVERSE story schema (pure types). One file per video: src/pv-stories/<id>/story.ts.
import type { Key } from "../engine/keyframes.ts";
import type { V3 } from "../engine/types.ts";
import type { CamKey } from "../engine/camera.ts";
import type { PoseKey, ExprKey } from "../engine/three/rig.ts";
import type { Look } from "../engine/three/looks.ts";
import type { SetSpec } from "../engine/three/setTypes.ts";
import type { PageCam, PanelKey, Pt } from "../engine/panels/geometry.ts";

type Params = Record<string, unknown>;
/** A prop that lives in a shot (bubble, phone, thought cloud, any library item…), keyframed. */
export type PropSpec = { kind: string; keys: Key<Params>[]; from?: number; to?: number };
export type ActorSpec = {
  cast: string; // key into story.cast
  pose: PoseKey[];
  expr: ExprKey[];
  anchor?: string; // parent to a set anchor (cliff halves…)
  torso?: PropSpec[];
  head?: PropSpec[];
  heldR?: PropSpec;
  heldL?: PropSpec;
  holdRotR?: V3;
  holdRotL?: V3;
  shadow?: boolean;
};
export type ShakeSpec = { at: number; dur: number; amp: number; seed?: number };
export type ShotDef = {
  start: number; // global frame of shot-local frame 0
  freezeAt?: number; // shot-local frame where time stops
  set: SetSpec;
  setKeys?: Key<Partial<SetSpec>>[]; // animate set fields (wall colour, cliff gap…) in shot frames
  bg: string;
  light?: V3;
  ink?: number;
  camera: CamKey[]; // shot-local frames
  shakes?: ShakeSpec[];
  actors: ActorSpec[];
  props?: PropSpec[];
};

export type SegmentType = "cut" | "slam" | "slide" | "iris" | "expand" | "collapse" | "fall" | "slash" | "shatter" | "drift" | "zoom" | "flip";
export type SfxCue = { at: number; src: string; volume: number; duck?: number; until?: number };
export type PanelCue = {
  shot: string;
  from: number;
  to: number;
  geom: PanelKey[];
  contentCenter?: Pt;
  shadow?: boolean;
  shatter?: { at: number; dur: number; impact: Pt; cuts: number[] };
  /** transition vocabulary used by this panel (for variety lint + automatic sound) */
  moves?: { type: SegmentType; at: number }[];
};

export type FxCue =
  | { kind: "impact"; at: number; to: number; text: string; x: number; y: number; size: number; rot?: number; fill?: string; font?: "impact" | "title" }
  | { kind: "caption"; at: number; to: number; text: string; x: number; y: number; size?: number; fill?: string }
  | { kind: "burst"; at: number; dur: number; x: number; y: number; r: number; fill?: string; inner?: string; seed?: number }
  | { kind: "speed"; from: number; to: number; cx?: number; cy?: number; inner?: number; opacity?: number; color?: string }
  | { kind: "flood"; at: number; dur: number; to: number; origins: Pt[] }
  | { kind: "flash"; at: number; dur?: number; color?: string }
  | { kind: "sfxText"; at: number; to: number; text: string; x: number; y: number; size: number; rot?: number; fill?: string }
  | { kind: "impactFrame"; at: number; dur?: number }
  | { kind: "stamp"; at: number; to: number; text: string; x: number; y: number; size?: number; rot?: number; color?: string }
  | { kind: "shock"; from: number; to: number; x: number; y: number; r?: number }
  | { kind: "halftoneWipe"; at: number; dur: number; to: number; color?: string; reverse?: boolean };

export type Ducking = { spans: [number, number][]; level: number; attack: number; release: number };
export type Beat = { at: number; words: string; idea: string; device: string };

export type StoryDef = {
  id: string;
  title?: string;
  fps: 60;
  durationInFrames: number;
  vo: { file: string; offset: number }; // public/<file>, seconds of silence before the VO
  cast: Record<string, Look>;
  shots: Record<string, ShotDef>;
  panels: PanelCue[];
  fx: FxCue[];
  sfx?: SfxCue[];
  autoSfx?: boolean; // default true: transitions + FX get their sounds automatically
  duck?: Ducking;
  page: { bg: string; cam: Key<Partial<PageCam>>[]; shakes: { at: number; dur: number; amp: number }[] };
  /** names of the story's own elements registered in elements.tsx */
  elements?: string[];
  /** the beat sheet the film was directed from (checked by the lint, kept for revisions) */
  beats?: Beat[];
};

==== 513 src/kits/panelverse/engine/camera.ts
// Camera state + keyframes (pure data; the 3D rig lives in three/ComicStage.tsx).
import { sample, type Key } from "./keyframes.ts";
import type { V3 } from "./types.ts";

export type CamState = { pos: V3; target: V3; fov: number; roll: number };
export type CamKey = Key<Partial<CamState>>;
export const CAM0: CamState = { pos: [0, 1.6, 6], target: [0, 1.4, 0], fov: 35, roll: 0 };
export const sampleCam = (keys: readonly CamKey[], f: number): CamState => ({ ...CAM0, ...sample<Partial<CamState>>(keys, f) });

==== 850 src/kits/panelverse/engine/FontGate.tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useDelayRender } from "remotion";
import { ensureFonts } from "../theme/fonts.ts";

/** Holds the render until the bundled comic fonts are ready, then mounts children (3D lettering needs them). */
export const FontGate: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const { delayRender, continueRender, cancelRender } = useDelayRender();
  const [handle] = useState(() => delayRender("PANELVERSE comic fonts"));
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    ensureFonts()
      .then(() => document.fonts.ready)
      .then(() => setReady(true))
      .catch((e) => cancelRender(e));
  }, [cancelRender]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (ready) continueRender(handle);
  }, [ready, handle, continueRender]);
  return ready ? <>{children}</> : null;
};

==== 15890 src/kits/panelverse/engine/fx/ComicFx.tsx
import React from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill } from "remotion";
import { INK, PAPER, RED, YELLOW } from "../../theme/palette.ts";
import { FONT_IMPACT, FONT_TITLE } from "../../theme/fonts.ts";
import { EASES, clamp, hash, prog } from "../keyframes.ts";

// ── InkBurst: jagged hand-cut explosion star ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const burstPath = (cx: number, cy: number, r: number, spikes: number, seed: number, jag = 0.38, squash = 1) => {
  const pts: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < spikes * 2; i++) {
    const a = (i / (spikes * 2)) * Math.PI * 2 + hash(seed + i * 0.37) * 0.08;
    const outer = i % 2 === 0;
    const rr = outer ? r * (0.9 + 0.22 * hash(seed + i * 1.7)) : r * (1 - jag) * (0.92 + 0.12 * hash(seed + i * 2.3));
    pts.push(`${(cx + Math.cos(a) * rr).toFixed(1)},${(cy + Math.sin(a) * rr * squash).toFixed(1)}`);
  }
  return `M${pts.join("L")}Z`;
};

export const InkBurst: React.FC<{
  f: number;
  at: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  r: number;
  fill?: string;
  inner?: string;
  spikes?: number;
  seed?: number;
  dur?: number;
  rot?: number;
  boil?: boolean;
}> = ({ f, at, x, y, r, fill = YELLOW, inner = RED, spikes = 14, seed = 1, dur = 40, rot = 0, boil = true }) => {
  if (f < at || f > at + dur) return null;
  const t = f - at;
  const s = EASES.outBackBig(clamp(t / 9)) * (t > dur - 8 ? (dur - t) / 8 : 1);
  const sd = boil ? seed + Math.floor(t / 3) * 0.13 : seed; // "boiling" redraw on threes, like hand animation
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: "none" }}>
      <svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920">
        <g transform={`translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${rot + t * 0.4}) scale(${s}) translate(${-x} ${-y})`}>
          <path d={burstPath(x + 10, y + 12, r, spikes, sd)} fill={INK} />
          <path d={burstPath(x, y, r, spikes, sd)} fill={fill} stroke={INK} strokeWidth={9} strokeLinejoin="round" />
          {inner ? <path d={burstPath(x, y, r * 0.62, spikes - 2, sd + 5, 0.3)} fill={inner} stroke={INK} strokeWidth={6} strokeLinejoin="round" /> : null}
        </g>
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ── SpeedLines: radial focus lines, redrawn on threes ─────────────────────────────────────────
export const SpeedLines: React.FC<{ f: number; from: number; to: number; cx?: number; cy?: number; color?: string; count?: number; inner?: number; opacity?: number }> = ({
  f,
  from,
  to,
  cx = 540,
  cy = 960,
  color = INK,
  count = 64,
  inner = 520,
  opacity = 1,
}) => {
  if (f < from || f > to) return null;
  const fadeIn = prog(f, from, from + 4);
  const fadeOut = 1 - prog(f, to - 8, to);
  const step = Math.floor(f / 3);
  const R = 1500;
  const paths: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = (i / count) * Math.PI * 2 + hash(i * 3.1 + step) * 0.05;
    const w = 0.008 + 0.014 * (hash(i * 7.7 + step * 1.3) + 1) * 0.5;
    const r0 = inner * (0.85 + 0.45 * (hash(i * 5.3 + step * 0.7) + 1) * 0.5);
    const p0 = [cx + Math.cos(a) * r0, cy + Math.sin(a) * r0];
    const p1 = [cx + Math.cos(a - w) * R, cy + Math.sin(a - w) * R];
    const p2 = [cx + Math.cos(a + w) * R, cy + Math.sin(a + w) * R];
    paths.push(`M${p0[0].toFixed(1)},${p0[1].toFixed(1)}L${p1[0].toFixed(1)},${p1[1].toFixed(1)}L${p2[0].toFixed(1)},${p2[1].toFixed(1)}Z`);
  }
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: "none", opacity: opacity * fadeIn * fadeOut }}>
      <svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920">
        <path d={paths.join("")} fill={color} />
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ── ImpactTypography: slammed comic lettering with printed 3D drop ───────────────────────────
export const ImpactTypography: React.FC<{
  f: number;
  at: number;
  to: number;
  text: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  size: number;
  rot?: number;
  fill?: string;
  font?: "impact" | "title";
  depth?: number;
  slam?: number;
  exit?: "pop" | "none";
}> = ({ f, at, to, text, x, y, size, rot = -6, fill = YELLOW, font = "impact", depth = 14, slam = 1.3, exit = "pop" }) => {
  if (f < at || f > to) return null;
  const t = f - at;
  // slam from slightly oversized with an overshoot; kept ≤1.3x so lettering never leaves the frame
  const inS = slam - (slam - 1) * EASES.outBackBig(clamp(t / 9));
  const fadeIn = clamp(t / 2.5);
  const outS = exit === "pop" ? 1 - EASES.inBack(prog(f, to - 7, to)) : 1;
  const jitter = Math.floor(f / 2);
  const jx = hash(jitter * 1.3) * 1.6;
  const jy = hash(jitter * 2.1) * 1.6;
  const family = font === "title" ? FONT_TITLE : FONT_IMPACT;
  const shadow = Array.from({ length: depth }, (_, i) => `${i + 1}px ${i + 1}px 0 ${INK}`).join(",");
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "absolute",
        left: x,
        top: y,
        transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${rot}deg) skewX(-6deg) scale(${Math.max(0, inS * outS)}) translate(${jx}px, ${jy}px)`,
        fontFamily: `"${family}"`,
        fontSize: size,
        lineHeight: 0.92,
        letterSpacing: font === "title" ? 2 : 4,
        color: fill,
        WebkitTextStroke: `${Math.round(size / 18)}px ${INK}`,
        paintOrder: "stroke fill",
        textShadow: shadow,
        whiteSpace: "pre",
        textAlign: "center",
        pointerEvents: "none",
        opacity: fadeIn,
      }}
    >
      {text}
    </div>
  );
};

// ── CaptionBox: narrator box (yellow, inked, offset print shadow) ─────────────────────────────
export const CaptionBox: React.FC<{ f: number; at: number; to: number; text: string; x: number; y: number; size?: number; rot?: number; fill?: string }> = ({
  f,
  at,
  to,
  text,
  x,
  y,
  size = 84,
  rot = -2,
  fill = YELLOW,
}) => {
  if (f < at || f > to) return null;
  const pIn = EASES.outBack(prog(f, at, at + 12));
  const pOut = prog(f, to - 8, to, "in");
  // letters type on like a letterer's hand
  const shown = Math.ceil(text.length * prog(f, at + 4, at + 24));
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "absolute",
        left: x,
        top: y,
        transform: `translate(${(1 - pIn) * -120 - pOut * 300}px, 0) rotate(${rot}deg)`,
        opacity: 1 - pOut,
        background: fill,
        border: `8px solid ${INK}`,
        boxShadow: `14px 14px 0 ${INK}`,
        padding: "14px 34px 8px",
        fontFamily: `"${FONT_IMPACT}"`,
        fontSize: size,
        letterSpacing: 4,
        color: INK,
        whiteSpace: "pre",
      }}
    >
      <span>{text.slice(0, shown)}</span>
      <span style={{ opacity: 0 }}>{text.slice(shown)}</span>
    </div>
  );
};

// ── Flash: one- or two-frame print flash (paper / ink) ─────────────────────────────────────────
export const Flash: React.FC<{ f: number; at: number; dur?: number; color?: string }> = ({ f, at, dur = 3, color = PAPER }) =>
  f >= at && f < at + dur ? <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: color, opacity: 1 - (f - at) / (dur + 1) }} /> : null;

// ── InkFlood: ComicTransition — ink splats bloom from impact points until the page is black ───
const blob = (cx: number, cy: number, r: number, seed: number, lobes = 11) => {
  const pts: [number, number][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lobes; i++) {
    const a = (i / lobes) * Math.PI * 2;
    const rr = r * (0.82 + 0.3 * (hash(seed + i * 1.91) + 1) * 0.5);
    pts.push([cx + Math.cos(a) * rr, cy + Math.sin(a) * rr]);
  }
  let d = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < lobes; i++) {
    const p0 = pts[i];
    const p1 = pts[(i + 1) % lobes];
    const mx = (p0[0] + p1[0]) / 2;
    const my = (p0[1] + p1[1]) / 2;
    if (i === 0) d += `M${mx.toFixed(1)},${my.toFixed(1)}`;
    const p2 = pts[(i + 2) % lobes];
    d += `Q${p1[0].toFixed(1)},${p1[1].toFixed(1)} ${((p1[0] + p2[0]) / 2).toFixed(1)},${((p1[1] + p2[1]) / 2).toFixed(1)}`;
  }
  return d + "Z";
};

export const InkFlood: React.FC<{ f: number; at: number; dur: number; to?: number; origins: [number, number][]; color?: string; reverse?: boolean }> = ({
  f,
  at,
  dur,
  to = 1e9,
  origins,
  color = INK,
  reverse = false,
}) => {
  if (f < at || f > to) return null;
  const p = clamp((f - at) / dur);
  const k = reverse ? 1 - EASES.inOut(p) : EASES.in(p) * 0.35 + EASES.inOut(p) * 0.65;
  if (k <= 0.001) return null;
  const R = 2300 * k;
  const d: string[] = [];
  origins.forEach(([x, y], i) => {
    d.push(blob(x, y, R * (0.55 + 0.2 * i), i * 13.7));
    // satellite droplets
    for (let j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
      const a = hash(i * 31 + j * 7.3) * Math.PI;
      const dist = R * (0.7 + 0.5 * (hash(i * 11 + j) + 1) * 0.5);
      d.push(blob(x + Math.cos(a) * dist, y + Math.sin(a) * dist, R * 0.12 * (0.6 + 0.4 * hash(j + i * 3)), i * 5 + j, 7));
    }
  });
  // vertical drips from the top edge
  for (let j = 0; j < 9; j++) {
    const x = 60 + j * 120 + hash(j) * 30;
    const len = R * 0.55 * (0.6 + 0.4 * (hash(j * 4.1) + 1) * 0.5);
    d.push(`M${x - 26},0 L${x + 26},0 L${x + 18},${len} Q${x},${len + 34} ${x - 18},${len} Z`);
  }
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: "none" }}>
      <svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920">
        <path d={d.join("")} fill={color} />
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ── Small hand-drawn accents ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const ShakeMarks: React.FC<{ f: number; from: number; to: number; x: number; y: number; r?: number; color?: string }> = ({ f, from, to, x, y, r = 120, color = INK }) => {
  if (f < from || f > to) return null;
  const on = Math.floor(f / 3) % 2 === 0;
  const arcs = [-1, 1].map((s) => {
    const a0 = s === -1 ? 150 : -30;
    const pts = [0, 1].map((k) => {
      const rr = r + k * 34;
      const a1 = ((a0 - 22) * Math.PI) / 180;
      const a2 = ((a0 + 22) * Math.PI) / 180;
      return `M${x + Math.cos(a1) * rr},${y + Math.sin(a1) * rr} A${rr},${rr} 0 0 1 ${x + Math.cos(a2) * rr},${y + Math.sin(a2) * rr}`;
    });
    return pts.join(" ");
  });
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: "none", opacity: on ? 1 : 0.55 }}>
      <svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920">
        <path d={arcs.join(" ")} stroke={color} strokeWidth={10} strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" />
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ── Onomatopoeia: hand-lettered sound word (KRING! DUG! BRAK!) — wobbly letters, coloured, inked ──
export const SfxText: React.FC<{ f: number; at: number; to: number; text: string; x: number; y: number; size: number; rot?: number; fill?: string }> = ({
  f,
  at,
  to,
  text,
  x,
  y,
  size,
  rot = 8,
  fill = RED,
}) => {
  if (f < at || f > to) return null;
  const t = f - at;
  const s = EASES.outBackBig(clamp(t / 8)) * (1 - EASES.in(prog(f, to - 6, to)));
  const boil = Math.floor(f / 3);
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: x, top: y, transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${rot}deg) scale(${s})`, whiteSpace: "pre", pointerEvents: "none" }}>
      {[...text].map((ch, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          style={{
            display: "inline-block",
            fontFamily: `"${FONT_IMPACT}"`,
            fontSize: size * (1 + 0.08 * hash(i * 3.1 + boil)),
            color: fill,
            WebkitTextStroke: `${Math.round(size / 14)}px ${INK}`,
            paintOrder: "stroke fill",
            textShadow: `6px 6px 0 ${INK}`,
            transform: `translateY(${hash(i * 7.7 + boil) * size * 0.06}px) rotate(${hash(i * 5.3 + boil * 0.5) * 9}deg)`,
            letterSpacing: 2,
          }}
        >
          {ch}
        </span>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

// ── Impact frame: 2–3 frames of inverted, high-contrast "negative" print (manga/comic hit) ─────
export const ImpactFrame: React.FC<{ f: number; at: number; dur?: number }> = ({ f, at, dur = 3 }) =>
  f >= at && f < at + dur ? <AbsoluteFill style={{ backdropFilter: "invert(1) grayscale(1) contrast(3)", WebkitBackdropFilter: "invert(1) grayscale(1) contrast(3)" }} /> : null;

// ── Rubber stamp: slams in rotated with an ink-bleed border (LUNAS / DITOLAK / GAGAL…) ──────────
export const Stamp: React.FC<{ f: number; at: number; to: number; text: string; x: number; y: number; size?: number; rot?: number; color?: string }> = ({
  f,
  at,
  to,
  text,
  x,
  y,
  size = 110,
  rot = -12,
  color = RED,
}) => {
  if (f < at || f > to) return null;
  const t = f - at;
  const s = 1.8 - 0.8 * EASES.out(clamp(t / 5));
  const o = clamp(t / 3) * (1 - prog(f, to - 6, to));
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "absolute",
        left: x,
        top: y,
        transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${rot}deg) scale(${s})`,
        opacity: o,
        border: `${Math.round(size / 9)}px solid ${color}`,
        borderRadius: 14,
        padding: `${size * 0.08}px ${size * 0.3}px ${size * 0.02}px`,
        fontFamily: `"${FONT_IMPACT}"`,
        fontSize: size,
        letterSpacing: 6,
        color,
        mixBlendMode: "multiply",
        whiteSpace: "pre",
        boxShadow: `inset 0 0 0 ${Math.round(size / 22)}px ${PAPER}`,
        pointerEvents: "none",
      }}
    >
      {text}
    </div>
  );
};

// ── Shock lines: short radiating strokes around a head (realisation, panic, "deg!") ────────────
export const ShockLines: React.FC<{ f: number; from: number; to: number; x: number; y: number; r?: number }> = ({ f, from, to, x, y, r = 150 }) => {
  if (f < from || f > to) return null;
  const k = EASES.outBack(clamp((f - from) / 6)) * (1 - prog(f, to - 5, to));
  const boil = Math.floor(f / 3);
  const d = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => {
    const a = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2 + hash(i + boil) * 0.12;
    const r0 = r * (1 + 0.08 * hash(i * 3 + boil)), r1 = r0 + r * 0.42 * k;
    return `M${(x + Math.cos(a) * r0).toFixed(1)},${(y + Math.sin(a) * r0).toFixed(1)}L${(x + Math.cos(a) * r1).toFixed(1)},${(y + Math.sin(a) * r1).toFixed(1)}`;
  }).join("");
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: "none" }}>
      <svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920">
        <path d={d} stroke={INK} strokeWidth={11} strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" />
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ── Halftone wipe: a printed dot screen grows until the frame is solid (or shrinks away) ───────
export const HalftoneWipe: React.FC<{ f: number; at: number; dur: number; to: number; color?: string; reverse?: boolean }> = ({ f, at, dur, to, color = INK, reverse }) => {
  if (f < at || f > to) return null;
  const p = clamp((f - at) / dur);
  const k = reverse ? 1 - EASES.inOut(p) : EASES.inOut(p);
  if (k <= 0.001) return null;
  const cell = 64;
  const dots: string[] = [];
  for (let gy = -1; gy < 1920 / cell + 1; gy++) {
    for (let gx = -1; gx < 1080 / cell + 2; gx++) {
      const cx = gx * cell + (gy % 2 ? cell / 2 : 0), cy = gy * cell;
      // dots grow in a diagonal sweep: top-left first
      const local = clamp(k * 1.6 - ((cx / 1080) * 0.35 + (cy / 1920) * 0.25));
      const r = local * cell * 0.75;
      if (r > 0.5) dots.push(`M${cx - r},${cy}a${r},${r} 0 1,0 ${2 * r},0a${r},${r} 0 1,0 ${-2 * r},0`);
    }
  }
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: "none" }}>
      <svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920">
        <path d={dots.join("")} fill={color} />
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/**
 * Vintage newsprint feel over the whole frame: fine fibre grain (multiply) + faint warm tooth.

 */
export const PaperTexture: React.FC<{ strength?: number; id?: string }> = ({ strength = 1, id = "paper" }) => (
  <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: "none", mixBlendMode: "multiply", opacity: 0.55 * strength }}>
    <svg width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

          in="n"
          type="matrix"
          values="0 0 0 0 0.93  0 0 0 0 0.86  0 0 0 0 0.72  0 0 0 -1.6 1.25"

  </AbsoluteFill>
);

==== 4469 src/kits/panelverse/engine/keyframes.ts
// Deterministic keyframe engine. Every animated value in PANELVERSE is a pure function of a frame
// number, so any frame renders identically in any tab, in any order.

export type EaseName =
  | "linear"
  | "in"
  | "out"
  | "inOut"
  | "outBack"
  | "outBackBig"
  | "inBack"
  | "outElastic"
  | "hold"
  | "expoOut"
  | "expoIn";

const c1 = 1.70158;
export const EASES: Record<EaseName, (t: number) => number> = {
  linear: (t) => t,
  in: (t) => t * t * t,
  out: (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3),
  inOut: (t) => (t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2),
  outBack: (t) => 1 + (c1 + 1) * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(t - 1, 2),
  outBackBig: (t) => {
    const c = 3.2;
    return 1 + (c + 1) * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + c * Math.pow(t - 1, 2);
  },
  inBack: (t) => (c1 + 1) * t * t * t - c1 * t * t,
  outElastic: (t) =>
    t === 0 || t === 1 ? t : Math.pow(2, -10 * t) * Math.sin((t * 10 - 0.75) * ((2 * Math.PI) / 3)) + 1,
  hold: () => 0,
  expoOut: (t) => (t >= 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)),
  expoIn: (t) => (t <= 0 ? 0 : Math.pow(2, 10 * t - 10)),
};

export const clamp = (v: number, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));
export const lerp = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t;
/** 0→1 progress of f through [a, b] with easing. */
export const prog = (f: number, a: number, b: number, ease: EaseName = "linear") =>
  EASES[ease](clamp((f - a) / Math.max(1e-6, b - a)));

type Val = number | string | boolean | readonly unknown[] | { [k: string]: unknown } | undefined;

const mix = (a: Val, b: Val, t: number): Val => {
  if (typeof a === "number" && typeof b === "number") return lerp(a, b, t);
  if (Array.isArray(a) && Array.isArray(b)) return a.map((x, i) => mix(x as Val, b[i] as Val, t));
  if (a && b && typeof a === "object" && typeof b === "object" && !Array.isArray(a)) {
    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    const ka = a as Record<string, unknown>;
    const kb = b as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const k of new Set([...Object.keys(ka), ...Object.keys(kb)])) {
      out[k] = k in ka && k in kb ? mix(ka[k] as Val, kb[k] as Val, t) : (kb[k] ?? ka[k]);
    }
    return out;
  }
  // discrete values switch at the halfway point of the transition
  return t < 0.5 ? a : b;
};

const merge = (base: Val, over: Val): Val => {
  if (over === undefined) return base;
  if (base && over && typeof base === "object" && typeof over === "object" && !Array.isArray(base) && !Array.isArray(over)) {
    const out: Record<string, unknown> = { ...(base as Record<string, unknown>) };
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(over as Record<string, unknown>)) out[k] = merge(out[k] as Val, v as Val);
    return out;
  }
  return over;
};

/** A keyframe: value `v` is reached at frame `f`, travelling from the previous key with `ease`. */
export type Key<T> = { f: number; v: T; ease?: EaseName };

/**
 * Sample a sparse keyframe track. Object keys are cumulative: each key only needs the fields that
 * change, the rest carry over from earlier keys.
 */
export function sample<T>(keys: readonly Key<T>[], f: number): T {
  if (keys.length === 0) throw new Error("empty track");
  // resolve cumulative values
  const full: { f: number; v: Val; ease: EaseName }[] = [];
  let acc: Val = undefined;
  for (const k of keys) {
    acc = merge(acc, k.v as Val);
    full.push({ f: k.f, v: acc, ease: k.ease ?? "inOut" });
  }
  if (f <= full[0].f) return full[0].v as T;
  for (let i = 1; i < full.length; i++) {
    if (f <= full[i].f) {
      const a = full[i - 1];
      const b = full[i];
      const t = EASES[b.ease](clamp((f - a.f) / Math.max(1e-6, b.f - a.f)));
      return mix(a.v, b.v, t) as T;
    }
  }
  return full[full.length - 1].v as T;
}

/** Deterministic hash noise in [-1, 1]. */
export const hash = (n: number) => {
  const s = Math.sin(n * 127.1 + 311.7) * 43758.5453;
  return (s - Math.floor(s)) * 2 - 1;
};
/** Smooth 1D value noise in [-1, 1]. */
export const noise1 = (x: number, seed = 0) => {
  const i = Math.floor(x);
  const fr = x - i;
  const u = fr * fr * (3 - 2 * fr);
  return lerp(hash(i + seed * 101.3), hash(i + 1 + seed * 101.3), u);
};

/** Decaying camera/impact shake: amplitude envelope starting at frame `at`. */
export const shake = (f: number, at: number, dur: number, amp: number, seed = 1, freq = 0.9) => {
  if (f < at || f > at + dur) return 0;
  const e = 1 - (f - at) / dur;
  return noise1((f - at) * freq, seed) * amp * e * e;
};

==== 7011 src/kits/panelverse/engine/panels/geometry.ts
// Panel geometry: pure data + math (no React), so story files can use it from Node and the browser.
import { sample, type Key } from "../keyframes.ts";

export type Pt = [number, number];
/** Clockwise from top-left, in 1080×1920 frame pixels. */
export type Quad = [Pt, Pt, Pt, Pt];
export type PanelGeom = {
  pts: Quad;
  move: Pt; // extra translation of the whole panel (slide in / fall away)
  rot: number; // degrees, around the panel centre
  scale: number;
  border: number; // ink border px (0 = none)
  /** 0 = quad window; >0 = circular window of this radius (px) centred on the quad (iris shots) */
  iris: number;
};
export type PanelKey = Key<Partial<PanelGeom>>;

export const W = 1080;
export const H = 1920;
export const FULL: Quad = [
  [-16, -16],
  [1096, -16],
  [1096, 1936],
  [-16, 1936],
];
export const PANEL0: PanelGeom = { pts: FULL, move: [0, 0], rot: 0, scale: 1, border: 8, iris: 0 };
export const samplePanel = (keys: readonly PanelKey[], f: number): PanelGeom => ({ ...PANEL0, ...sample<Partial<PanelGeom>>(keys, f) });

export const centerOf = (q: readonly Pt[]): Pt => {
  const xs = q.map((p) => p[0]);
  const ys = q.map((p) => p[1]);
  return [(Math.min(...xs) + Math.max(...xs)) / 2, (Math.min(...ys) + Math.max(...ys)) / 2];
};
export const boundsOf = (q: readonly Pt[]) => {
  const xs = q.map((p) => p[0]);
  const ys = q.map((p) => p[1]);
  return { x0: Math.min(...xs), y0: Math.min(...ys), x1: Math.max(...xs), y1: Math.max(...ys) };
};

// ── Layout library ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Every layout keeps panels inside the mobile-safe page area (x 56–1024, y 200–1580) with ≈28 px
// gutters and slight slants, so pages read as printed comics, not UI grids.
const X0 = 60, X1 = 1020, Y0 = 214, Y1 = 1572, G = 30;
const q = (x0: number, y0: number, x1: number, y1: number, tl = 0, tr = 0, br = 0, bl = 0): Quad => [
  [x0, y0 + tl],
  [x1, y0 + tr],
  [x1, y1 + br],
  [x0, y1 + bl],
];
const rows = (n: number, slant: number) => {
  const h = (Y1 - Y0 - G * (n - 1)) / n;
  return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {
    const y0 = Y0 + i * (h + G), y1 = y0 + h;
    const s0 = i === 0 ? 0 : (i % 2 ? slant : -slant), s1 = i === n - 1 ? 0 : (i % 2 ? -slant : slant);
    return q(X0, y0, X1, y1, s0, -s0, s1, -s1);
  });
};
export const LAYOUTS = {
  /** one full-bleed image */
  splash: (): Quad[] => [FULL],
  /** one printed panel with paper margins (freeze / end page) */
  page: (): Quad[] => [[[56, 210], [1024, 182], [1024, 1536], [56, 1572]]],
  /** two stacked panels, slanted gutter */
  twoUp: (slant = 26): Quad[] => rows(2, slant),
  /** three stacked bands (the classic overthinking page) */
  threeUp: (slant = 20): Quad[] => rows(3, slant),
  /** four stacked strips (lists, countdowns) */
  fourUp: (slant = 14): Quad[] => rows(4, slant),
  /** 2 × 2 grid */
  grid4: (): Quad[] => {
    const xm = 540, ym = (Y0 + Y1) / 2;
    return [
      q(X0, Y0, xm - G / 2 + 10, ym - G / 2, 0, 0, -8, 6),
      q(xm + G / 2 + 10, Y0, X1, ym - G / 2 - 8, 0, 0, 8, 0),
      q(X0, ym + G / 2 + 6, xm - G / 2 - 10, Y1, 0, -8, 0, 0),
      q(xm + G / 2 - 10, ym + G / 2 - 8, X1, Y1, 8, 0, 0, 0),
    ];
  },
  /** two tall columns (side-by-side comparison: ekspektasi / realita) */
  twoCol: (): Quad[] => [
    [[X0, Y0], [540 - G / 2 + 24, Y0], [540 - G / 2 - 24, Y1], [X0, Y1]],
    [[540 + G / 2 + 24, Y0], [X1, Y0], [X1, Y1], [540 + G / 2 - 24, Y1]],
  ],
  /** one big panel on top + two small side by side below */
  bigTop: (): Quad[] => {
    const ym = Y0 + (Y1 - Y0) * 0.6;
    return [
      q(X0, Y0, X1, ym - G / 2, 0, 0, -14, 14),
      [[X0, ym + G / 2 + 14], [540 - G / 2 + 12, ym + G / 2 + 2], [540 - G / 2 - 12, Y1], [X0, Y1]],
      [[540 + G / 2 + 12, ym + G / 2], [X1, ym + G / 2 - 14], [X1, Y1], [540 + G / 2 - 12, Y1]],
    ];
  },
  /** two small side by side on top + one big panel below */
  bigBottom: (): Quad[] => {
    const ym = Y0 + (Y1 - Y0) * 0.4;
    return [
      [[X0, Y0], [540 - G / 2 + 12, Y0], [540 - G / 2 - 12, ym - G / 2 + 10], [X0, ym - G / 2 + 18]],
      [[540 + G / 2 + 12, Y0], [X1, Y0], [X1, ym - G / 2], [540 + G / 2 - 12, ym - G / 2 + 8]],
      q(X0, ym + G / 2 + 18, X1, Y1, 0, -18, 0, 0),
    ];
  },
  /** three tall vertical strips (a moment in three beats) */
  strip3: (): Quad[] => {
    const w = (X1 - X0 - 2 * G) / 3;
    return [0, 1, 2].map((i) => {
      const x0 = X0 + i * (w + G), x1 = x0 + w;
      return [[x0 + (i ? 14 : 0), Y0], [x1 + (i < 2 ? 14 : 0), Y0], [x1 - (i < 2 ? 14 : 0), Y1], [x0 - (i ? 14 : 0), Y1]] as Quad;
    });
  },
  /** full-bleed diagonal split (no margins): versus / before-after */
  diagonal: (cut = 160): Quad[] => [
    [[-16, -16], [1096, -16], [1096, 960 - cut - 14], [-16, 960 + cut - 14]],
    [[-16, 960 + cut + 14], [1096, 960 - cut + 14], [1096, 1936], [-16, 1936]],
  ],
  /** full-bleed image + a small inset panel in a corner */
  inset: (corner: "br" | "bl" | "tr" | "tl" = "br", w = 440, h = 420): Quad[] => {
    const x0 = corner.endsWith("r") ? 1030 - w : 50, y0 = corner.startsWith("b") ? 1560 - h : 230;
    return [FULL, [[x0, y0 + 20], [x0 + w, y0], [x0 + w, y0 + h - 20], [x0, y0 + h]]];
  },
};
export type LayoutName = keyof typeof LAYOUTS;

/** Split a quad into shards (fan from an impact point) for the panel-shatter transition. */
export const shardsOf = (quad: readonly Pt[], impact: Pt, cuts: number[]): Pt[][] => {
  const edges: [Pt, Pt][] = quad.map((p, i) => [p, quad[(i + 1) % quad.length]]);
  const lens = edges.map(([a, b]) => Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]));
  const total = lens.reduce((s, l) => s + l, 0);
  const at = (t: number): Pt => {
    let d = (((t % 1) + 1) % 1) * total;
    for (let i = 0; i < edges.length; i++) {
      if (d <= lens[i]) {
        const [a, b] = edges[i];
        const k = d / lens[i];
        return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k];
      }
      d -= lens[i];
    }
    return quad[0];
  };
  const corners: number[] = [];
  let acc = 0;
  for (const l of lens) {
    corners.push(acc / total);
    acc += l;
  }
  const sorted = [...cuts].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return sorted.map((c0, i) => {
    const c1 = i === sorted.length - 1 ? sorted[0] + 1 : sorted[i + 1];
    const pts: Pt[] = [impact, at(c0)];
    for (const k of [...corners, ...corners.map((x) => x + 1)]) if (k > c0 && k < c1) pts.push(at(k));
    pts.push(at(c1));
    return pts;
  });
};

// ── Page camera (2.5D move over the printed page) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
export type PageCam = { x: number; y: number; scale: number; rot: number; tiltX: number; tiltY: number };
export const PAGECAM0: PageCam = { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, rot: 0, tiltX: 0, tiltY: 0 };

==== 4251 src/kits/panelverse/engine/panels/LivingPanel.tsx
import React from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill } from "remotion";
import { INK, PAPER } from "../../theme/palette.ts";
import { centerOf, type PageCam, type PanelGeom, type Pt } from "./geometry.ts";

const poly = (q: readonly Pt[]) => q.map((p) => `${p[0].toFixed(1)}px ${p[1].toFixed(1)}px`).join(",");
const pathOf = (q: readonly Pt[]) => `M${q.map((p) => `${p[0].toFixed(1)},${p[1].toFixed(1)}`).join("L")}Z`;

/**
 * LivingPanel: a comic panel window. Its content (normally a full-frame ComicStage canvas) is centred
 * on `contentCenter` and clipped to the panel quad — or to a circle (`geom.iris` > 0) — so panels can
 * split, expand, collapse, tilt, iris and shatter while the 3D scene inside keeps rendering live.
 */
export const LivingPanel: React.FC<{
  geom: PanelGeom;
  contentCenter?: Pt;
  bg?: string;
  dropShadow?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ geom, contentCenter, bg = PAPER, dropShadow = true, children }) => {
  const c = centerOf(geom.pts);
  const cc = contentCenter ?? c;
  const tf = `translate(${geom.move[0]}px, ${geom.move[1]}px) translate(${c[0]}px, ${c[1]}px) rotate(${geom.rot}deg) scale(${geom.scale}) translate(${-c[0]}px, ${-c[1]}px)`;
  const iris = geom.iris > 0.5;
  const clip = iris ? `circle(${geom.iris.toFixed(1)}px at ${c[0].toFixed(1)}px ${c[1].toFixed(1)}px)` : `polygon(${poly(geom.pts)})`;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ transform: tf, transformOrigin: "0 0" }}>
      {dropShadow ? (
        <svg width="1080" height="1920" style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, top: 0, overflow: "visible" }}>
          {iris ? <circle cx={c[0] + 12} cy={c[1] + 14} r={geom.iris} fill={INK} /> : <path d={pathOf(geom.pts)} fill={INK} transform="translate(12 14)" />}
        </svg>
      ) : null}
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, top: 0, width: 1080, height: 1920, clipPath: clip, background: bg }}>
        <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: cc[0] - 540, top: cc[1] - 960, width: 1080, height: 1920 }}>{children}</div>
      </div>
      {geom.border > 0 ? (
        <svg width="1080" height="1920" style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, top: 0, overflow: "visible" }}>
          {iris ? (
            <circle cx={c[0]} cy={c[1]} r={geom.iris} fill="none" stroke={INK} strokeWidth={geom.border} />
          ) : (
            <path d={pathOf(geom.pts)} fill="none" stroke={INK} strokeWidth={geom.border} strokeLinejoin="miter" />
          )}
        </svg>
      ) : null}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

export const PageCamera: React.FC<{ cam: PageCam; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ cam, children }) => (
  <AbsoluteFill style={{ perspective: 2400, perspectiveOrigin: "540px 960px" }}>
    <AbsoluteFill
      style={{
        transform: `translate(${cam.x}px, ${cam.y}px) scale(${cam.scale}) rotate(${cam.rot}deg) rotateX(${cam.tiltX}deg) rotateY(${cam.tiltY}deg)`,
        transformOrigin: "540px 960px",
        transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  </AbsoluteFill>
);

/** A shard of a panel: clipped copy of the panel content, flying away. */
export const PanelShard: React.FC<{ pts: Pt[]; contentCenter: Pt; move: Pt; rot: number; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({
  pts,
  contentCenter,
  move,
  rot,
  children,
}) => {
  const c = centerOf(pts);
  const tf = `translate(${move[0]}px, ${move[1]}px) translate(${c[0]}px, ${c[1]}px) rotate(${rot}deg) translate(${-c[0]}px, ${-c[1]}px)`;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ transform: tf, transformOrigin: "0 0" }}>
      <svg width="1080" height="1920" style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, top: 0, overflow: "visible" }}>
        <path d={pathOf(pts)} fill={INK} transform="translate(10 12)" />
      </svg>
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, top: 0, width: 1080, height: 1920, clipPath: `polygon(${poly(pts)})` }}>
        <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: contentCenter[0] - 540, top: contentCenter[1] - 960, width: 1080, height: 1920 }}>{children}</div>
      </div>
      <svg width="1080" height="1920" style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, top: 0, overflow: "visible" }}>
        <path d={pathOf(pts)} fill="none" stroke={INK} strokeWidth={7} strokeLinejoin="round" />
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

==== 1345 src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/canvasTexture.ts
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { CanvasTexture, LinearFilter, SRGBColorSpace } from "three";

/**
 * A 2D-canvas texture redrawn synchronously whenever `key` changes. Fonts are guaranteed loaded by
 * <FontGate> before any 3D stage mounts, so text drawn here is always the real comic lettering.
 */
export const useCanvasTexture = (w: number, h: number, key: string, draw: (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, w: number, h: number) => void) => {
  const { canvas, tex } = useMemo(() => {
    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width = w;
    c.height = h;
    const t = new CanvasTexture(c);
    t.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace;
    t.minFilter = LinearFilter;
    t.magFilter = LinearFilter;
    t.anisotropy = 4;
    return { canvas: c, tex: t };
  }, [w, h]);
  useMemo(() => {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    draw(ctx, w, h);
    tex.needsUpdate = true;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [canvas, key]);
  return tex;
};

export const roundRect = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, r: number) => {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
};
